न: न The twentieth consonant of the Deva Nāgri Alphābet, correspon-ding with the letter N.

न mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Thin, spare. 	 2. Vacant, empty. 	 3. Identical, same, like. 	 4. Unvexed, unwearied 5. Undivided, unbroken. 	 m. (नः) 	 1. A Bauddha, a follower of Buddha. 	 2. Binding, tying. 	 3. One who is praised. 	 4. A name of GANESA. 	 5. War. 	 6. Giving, a gift. 	 7. Good, welfare, prosperity. 	 8. A jewel. 	 f. (ना) 	 1. The navel. 	 2. A musical instrument. 	 3. Knowledge. ind. 	 1. No, not, a particle of prohibition. 	 2. A particle of comparison. 	 3. A particle of negation, annihilation, &c.  E. नी to obtain, or नह् to bind, &c. ड aff.
नःक्षुद्र: नःक्षुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Small-nosed.  E. नस् the nose, क्षुद्र small.
नंशुक: नंशुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Injurious, destructive.  E. नश् to destroy, णुकन् Unādi affix and नुम् inserted.
नंष्टृ: नंष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) An injurious, destructive. नश् to destroy, affix तृच् and नुम् inserted.
नकुल: नकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Disgraced, rejected from a family or race. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. The Bengal mungoose, (Viverra ichneumon) 	 2. A proper name, NAKULA, the fourth of the five Pāṇḍu princes. 	 3. A son. 4. A name of SIVA. 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. Silk cotton tree, 2. Indian spikenard. 3. A sort of perfume: see शङ्क्षिनी. Saffron. 	 4. The letter ह as used in the Tantras.  E. न not, कुल race or heap, fem. affix ङीष्.
नकुलेश: नकुलेश m. (-शः) 	 1. A Bhairava, an attendant on or emanation from SIVA. 	 2. The letter ह as used mystically in Tantras.  E. नकुल, and ईश master.
नकुलेष्टा: नकुलेष्टा f. (-ष्टा) A plant: see रास्ना.  E. नकुल an ichneumon, and इष्ट wished; the mungoose, if wounded in a conflict with a poisonous snake, is supposed to prevent the effects of the venom by the use of this plant; also नकुलेष्टका.
नक्क: नक्क r. 10th cl. (नक्कयति-ते) To destroy or annihilate. चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट्
नक्त: नक्त n. (-क्तं) Night.  E. नज् to be ashamed, क्त aff.
नक्तक: नक्तक m. (-कः) 	 1. Dirty or ragged cloth. 	 2. A rag, a wiper, a hand-kerchief, &c.  E. नज् to be ashamed or modest, affix तन् and कन् added; also लक्तक.
नक्तचारिन्: नक्तचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Going or moving about at night. 	 m. (-री) 1. A cat. 	 2. An owl. 	 3. A goblin. 	 4. A thief.  E. नक्त by night, चर् to go, णिनि aff.
नक्तञ्चर: नक्तञ्चर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going at night. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A goblin, a demon. 2. A tree, the Bdellium tree: see गुग्गुल. 	 3. An owl, 4. A thief. E. नक्त by night, and चर who goes. नक्तं रात्रौ चरति चर-ट ।
नक्तभोजन: नक्तभोजन n. (-नं) Supper.  E. नक्त night, भोजन food.
नक्तन्: नक्तन् ind. By night, at night.  E. नज् to be ashamed, तनिन् aff.
नक्तमाल: नक्तमाल m. (-लः) A tree, (Galedupa arborea, Rox.)  E. नक्तम् by night, अल् to ornament, आङ् prefix and अच् affix; blossoming at night. करञ्ज वृक्षे । नक्तम् आ अलति अल-अच् ।
नक्तमुखा: नक्तमुखा f. (-खा) Night.  E. नक्तम् by night, उख् to produce, affix क । नक्तव्रताङ्गं मुखमाद्यभागोऽस्याः ।
नक्तव्रत: नक्तव्रत n. (-तं) 	 1. Fasting by day and eating at night.  E. नक्त and व्रत vow.
नक्र: नक्र n. (-क्रं) The upper timber of a door-frame. 	 nf. (-क्रं-क्रा) The nose. 	 f. (क्रा) A string of bees or wasps m. (-क्रः) A crocodile.  E. न not, क्रम् to go affix ड. न क्रामति दूरस्थानम् ।
नक्रराज्: नक्रराज् m. (-राट्) or नक्रराज m. (-जः) A shark, but applied also differ-ently: see ग्राह.  E. नक्र a crocodile, and राज् or राज king.
नक्षत्र: नक्षत्र n. (-त्र) 	 1. A star in general. 	 2. An asterism in the moon's path or lunar mansion, of which twenty-eight, distinct in name, figure, and number of stars, are enumerated; the Pourānic and popular enumeration of those constellations is twenty-seven; Abhijit, the twenty-eighth, being considered as formed of portions of the two contiguous asterisms, and not distinct from them 2. A pearl. E. नक्ष् to go, Unādi, affix अत्रन् or क्षद Sautra root, to injure, or क्षर् to drop, or क्षी to waste or decay, with the negative prefix, and ष्ट्रन् affix; deriv. irr. न क्षीयते क्षरते वा ।
नक्षत्रचक्र: नक्षत्रचक्र n. (-र्क्र) 	 1. A particular diagram for astrological calculations 2. The lunar asterisms collectively.  E. नक्षत्र and चक्र a circle.
नक्षत्रनेमि: नक्षत्रनेमि m. (-मिः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. The pole-star. 	 3. VISHNŪ. 	 f. (-मिः) The last of the asterisms, Revati, containing thirty-two stars. E. नक्षत्र a star, and नेमि circumference.
नक्षत्रप: नक्षत्रप m. (-पः) The moon.  E. नक्षत्र and प who cherishes.
नक्षत्रमाला: नक्षत्रमाला f. (-ला) 	 1. A necklace containing twenty-seven pearls. 	 2. The table of the asterisms in the moon's path. 	 3. A kind of dance. E. नक्षत्र a constellation, and माला a garland.
नक्षत्रेश: नक्षत्रेश m. (-शः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. Camphor.  E. नक्षत्र an asterism, and ईश lord.
नख: नख r. 1st cl. (नखति) To move. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।

नख mf. (-खः-खी) A finger nail. 	 m. (-खः) A part, a portion. 	 nf. (-खं-खी) A perfume, a dried substance, of a brown colour, and of the shape of a nail; apparently, a dried shell-fish, used as a perfume. f. (-खी) A vegetable perfume, different from the one above, though known by the same name, NAKHI.  E. न privative, ख sense; or नह् to bind ख Unādi affix, the radical ह rejected. नखम् छिद्रम् अत्र ।
नखकुट्ट: नखकुट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A barber.  E. नख a nail, and कुट्ट who cuts, (barbers in India trim the nails, नखं कुट्टति कुट्ट-छेदे अण् उप० स० ।
नखखादिन्: नखखादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what eats with nails or tal-ons.  E. नख, and खादिन् eating.
नखदारण: नखदारण m. (-णः) A falcon.  E. नख a nail, and दारण tearing.
नखपद: नखपद n. (-दं) A scratch, the mark of a finger nail.  E. नख, and पद a mark.
नखभिन्न: नखभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Torn, or torn off with a nail.  E. नख, and भिन्न divided.
नखमुच: नखमुच m. (-चः) A bow.  E. नख a nail, मुच् to let loose, क aff.
नखम्पच: नखम्पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) What scalds the nail.  E. नख, and पच् to cook, खश् aff. मुम् च ।
नखर: नखर m. (-रः) A finger nail. 	 f. (-री) A perfume: see नखी.  E. न not, खन् to go, and डर affix; or नख a nail, रा to go or be, affix ड. or नखं-राति-रा + क ।
नखरञ्जनी: नखरञ्जनी f. (-नी) A nail-parer.  E. नख, and रञ्जनी beautifying.
नखरायुध: नखरायुध m. (-धः) 	 1. A lion. 	 2. Any beast of prey. 	 3. A cook.  E. नखर a nail, आयुध a weapon.
नखलेखा: नखलेखा f. (-खा) A scratch  E. नख, and लेखा a line.
नखविलेख: नखविलेख m. (-खः) A scratch.  E. नख, and विलेखा a mark.
नखविष्किर: नखविष्किर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) What tears or rends, (as a bird of prey, &c.) E. नख, and विष्किर what scatters.
नखव्रण: नखव्रण n. (-णं) A scratch.  E. नख, and व्रण a wound.
नखशङ्ख: नखशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) A small shell.  E. नख a nail, शङ्ख a shell, one as small as a nail.
नखांशु: नखांशु m. (-शुः) Elegance of the finger nails.  E. नख, and अंशु a ray.
नखाङ्क: नखाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 	 1. A scratch, a mark of the nail. 	 2. A sort of perfume. E. नख a nail, and अङ्क a mark.
नखायुध: नखायुध m. (-धः) 	 1. A tiger. 	 2. A lion. 	 3. A cock. 	 4. Any beast or bird having talons.  E. नख, and आयुध a weapon.
नखालि: नखालि m. (-लिः) A small.  E. नख a nail, and आलि a line; also नखालिका
नखाशिन्: नखाशिन् m. (-शी) An owl.  E. नख a nail, and अशिन् who eats, using its claws in feeding.
नखिन्: नखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Nailed, clawed, having nails or talons. E. नख, and इनि aff.
नग: नग m. (-गः) 	 1. mountain. 	 2. A tree.  E. न not, गम् to go, affix ड, im-moveable; or दह् to burn, Unādi affix ग, ह rejected, and द changed to न.
नगज: नगज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Mountain, mountaineer. 	 m. (-जः) An elephant. E. नग a mountain, and ज born.
नगनन्दिनी: नगनन्दिनी f. (-नी) The goddess DURGĀ.  E. नग mountain, and नन्दिनी a daughter, being in one of her characters the daughter of Himā-laya, the snowy mountain personified.
नगपति: नगपति m. (-तिः) Himālaya, the personified range of snowy mountains dividing India from Tārtāry, &c.  E. नग mountain, and पति lord.
नगभिद्: नगभिद् m. (-द् or -त्) 	 1. A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.) 	 2. An axe, a crow. 	 3. INDRA.  E. नग, and भिद्, what breaks. नगं भिनत्ति भिद-क्विप-६ त० स ।
नगभू: नगभू mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु) Mountain, mountaineer.  E. नग, and भू born. नगे भवति-भू-क्विप् ७ त० स ।
नगमूर्द्धन्: नगमूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) The crest or brow of a mountain.  E. नग, and मूर्द्धन् forehead.
नगर: नगर nf. (-रं-री) A town, a city.  E. नग a tree, or according to some, a mountain, रल् affix; having trees or houses like mountains. नगा इव प्रासादाः सन्ति अत्र बा० र ।
नगरघात: नगरघात m. (-तः) An elephant,  E. नगर a city, and घात who destroys or subverts. नगरं हन्ति अमनुष्य कर्त्तृ कत्वेन टकं बाधिन्वा अण् उप० स० । हस्तिनि हन-भावे घञ् ६ त० । नगरस्थलोकस्य हनने च ।
नगरजन: नगरजन m. (-नः) Towns-folk, citizen.  E. नगर, and जन people.
नगरस्थ: नगरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) City, citizen.  E. नगर, and स्थ who or what stays.
नगरस्वरूपिणी: नगरस्वरूपिणी f. (-णी) A species of the Anushtubh metre.
नगरीवक: नगरीवक m. (-कः) A crow.  E. नगरी, and वक a crane, the town-crane.
नगरोपान्त: नगरोपान्त n. (-न्तं) Suburb, skirts of the town.  E. नग, and उपान्त vicinity.
नगरौषधि: नगरौषधि (धी) f. (-धिः) The plantain.  E. नगर a city, and औषधि a medica-ment.
नगाटन: नगाटन m. (-नः) A monkey.  E. नग a mountain, अट् to go, affix ल्युट्.
नगाधिप: नगाधिप m. (-पः) Himālaya; see नगपति.  E. नग mountain, and अधिप a lord; also नगाधिराज, &c.
नगाश्रय: नगाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Living in or frequenting mountains.  E. नग, and आश्रय abode. हस्तिकन्दवृक्षे, पर्वतवासिनि ।
नगोच्छ्राय: नगोच्छ्राय n. (-यं) The elevation of a mountain.  E. नग and उच्छ्राय heighth.
नगौकस्: नगौकस् m. (-काः) 	 1. A bird in general 2. A lion 3. A fabulous animal: see शरभ. 	 4. A crow.  E. नग a tree, a mountain, and ओकस् a house or dwelling.
नग्न: नग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Naked. 	 m. (-ग्नः) 	 1. A naked mendicant. 	 2. A Bauddha. 	 3. A bard. 	 f. (-ग्ना) A naked woman.  E. नज् to be as-hamed, affix कर्त्तरि क्त.
नग्नक: नग्नक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Naked.  E. कन् added to the last.
नग्नजित्: नग्नजित् m. (-जित्) The name of a king, father of one of KRISHṆA'S wives E. नग्न Bauddha, and जित् who conquers.
नग्नत्व: नग्नत्व n. (-त्वं) Nudity, nakedness.  E. त्व added to नग्न; also with तल्, नग्नता.
नग्नहू: नग्नहू mn. (-हूः-हु) Ferment, a drug used to throw the mixture for spirituous liquor into fermentation.  E. नग्न naked, and ह्वे to call, affix क्विप्, what is called for by the bare-faced, shameless, &c.
नग्नाट: नग्नाट m. (-टः) 	 1. A naked man, but especially a kind of religious men-dicant, who wanders about without clothes. 	 2. A Bauddha. 	 3. A Jain.  E. नग्न naked, and अट who goes; also with कन् added नग्नाटक, नग्न एव अटति अट-अच् स्वार्थे क अट-ण्वुल् वा ।
नग्निका: नग्निका f. (-का) 	 1. A girl before menstruation or about ten years old. 2. A naked woman.  E. नग्न naked, संज्ञायां कन् added: and the fem. from, see नग्नक ।
नग्नीकरण: नग्नीकरण n. (-णं) Stripping, undressing.  E. नग्न, and करण making, च्वि augment.
नग्नीकृत: नग्नीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Undressed, stripped, naked.  E. नग्न, and कृत made, च्वि aff.
नज: नज (ओ ई) ओनजी r. 6th cl. (नजते) also (इ, ओ) (ओनजि) r. 1st cl. (नञ्जते) To be ashamed, to be modest or bashful. तुदा० आ० अक० सेट् भ्वा० इदित् च ।
नज्: नज् ind. A particle of negation, prohibition, &c. (no, not:) see अ and न ।
नट: नट r. 1st and 10th cls. (नटति नाटयति-ते) 	 1. To dance, to dance as an actor, to act. 	 2. To drop or fall. 	 3. To shake, to move slightly. 	 4. To injure. 	 5. To shine. भ्वा० प० चुरा० उभ० अक० सेट् ।

नट m. (-टः) 	 1. A dancer, a mime, an actor, a Nata, &c. in modern times: in caste, the son of a degraded Kshetriya by a woman of the second caste. 	 4. A sort of reed, (Arundo tibialis, or latterly called A. karka, Roxburgh's Catalogue;) also नड and नल, 5. A subordi-nate mode of music. 	 f. (-टा) A sort of shrub, (Cæsalpinia bonduc-cella.) 	 f. (-टी) 	 1. A medicinal plant: see नली. 	 2. A whore. 	 3. A Nautch-girl, a dancer, an actress. 	 2. Red arsenic: see नली. 	 5. A Rāgini. E. नट् to dance, affixes अच्, and टाप् or ङीष्; otherwise, नश् to destroy Uṇadi affix डट, &c.
नटन: नटन n. (-नं) The art or act of dancing, pantomime, &c.  E. नट् to dance affix भावे ल्युट् ।
नटनारायण: नटनारायण m. (-णः) A Rāga or mode of music, according to some, the sixth, or to others, a subdivision of Dīpaka or of Megha.  E. नट, and नारायण VISHṆU: the supreme with dancers, &c.
नटमण्डन: नटमण्डन m. (-नः) Yellow orpiment.  E. नट an actor, and मण्डन adorning; dying theatrical raiment. नटं मण्डयति-मण्डि-ल्यु हरिताले ।
नटवर: नटवर m. (-रः) A chief dancer or actor.  E. नट, and वर best.
नटसंज्ञक: नटसंज्ञक m. (-कः) 	 1. Yellow orpiment, 2. An actor, a dancer, &c.  E. नट an actor, संज्ञा a name, affix कन् । गोदन्ताख्यहरिताले ।
नटश्रेष्ठ: नटश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A chief or excellent dancer or actor.  E. नट, and श्रेष्ठ best.
नटान्तिका: नटान्तिका f. (-का) Shame, modesty,  E. टन dancing, and अन्त destroying, affixes कन् and टाप्; it is also read नटान्धिका ।
नटेश्वर: नटेश्वर m. (-रः) A name of SIVA,  E. नट a dancer, and ईश्वर a deity, the god of the dancers.
नड: नड r. 1st cl. (नडति) To be thick or impervious. r. 10th cl. (नाडयति-ते) To fall off or from. भ्रंशे भ्वा० प० चुरा० उभ० अक० सेट् ।

नड (ल) m. (-डः or -लः) 	 1. A sort of reed, (Arundo tibialis, or karka;) also नल. 	 2. A particular tribe whose employment is making a sort of glass bracelets.  E. नड् to be thick, affix अच् । नल वन्धे अच् वा डस्य-लः ।
नड(ल)मीन m. (-नः) A small fish a kind of sprat haunting reedy places. E. नड a reed, and मीन a fish. “चिंडौ” मत्स्ये ।
नडकोय: नडकोय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Abounding in reeds, (a field, &c.)  E. नड a reed, छ affix, and कुक् augment.
नडप्राय: नडप्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Abounding in reeds.  E. नड, and प्राय aboun-dance.
नडसंहति: नडसंहति f. (-तिः) A quantity of reeds.  E. नड, and संहति assemblage; also any analogous compound.
नडह: नडह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Lovely, beautiful, desirable.  E. नड here said to be mental anxiety, derived form नड् to fall off or from, हन् to destroy, affix ड ।
नड्या: नड्या f. (-ड्या) A quantity of reed.  E. नड a reed, affix यत्.
नड्वन्: नड्वन् mfn. (-ड्वान्-ड्वती-ड्वत्) Reedy, abounding in reeds.  E. नड, and नतुप् aff.

नन्दि: नन्दि mn. (-न्दिः-न्दि) 	 1. Gambling, gaming. 	 2. Happiness. 	 m. (-न्दिः) 	 1. One of SIVA'S principal attendants. 	 2. The speaker of the prologue or prelude to a drama. 	 3. One who pronounces a benediction. E. नदि to make happy, and इन् Unādi aff.

नन्दिघोष: नन्दिघोष m. (-षः) 	 1. The car of ARJUNA. 	 2. The acclaim or proclam-ation of a panegyrist or herald.  E. नन्दि happy, and धोष sound.
नन्दिन्: नन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) Happy, rejoiced, delighted. 	 m. (-न्दी) 	 1. The name of one of ŚIVA'S chamberlains, and chief attendants. 	 2. The Indian fig tree. 	 3. Parspipal, (Hibiscus populneoides.) 	 4. The speaker of the prelude or prologue to a drama. 	 f. (-न्दिनी) 	 1. A name of the goddess PĀRVATI. 	 2. GANGĀ, the river goddess. 	 3. E. नन्द happiness, णिनि aff.

नन्द्यावर्त: नन्द्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 	 1. A sort of temple. 	 2. A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria:) see तगर. 	 3. A peculiar diagram.  E. नन्दी happiness, आवर्त्त abode. नन्दी आवर्त्तो यत्र ।
नन्द्यावर्त्त: नन्द्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 	 1. A sort of temple. 	 2. A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria:) see तगर. 	 3. A peculiar diagram.  E. नन्दी happiness, आवर्त्त abode. नन्दी आवर्त्तो यत्र ।
नन्नम्यमान: नन्नम्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bending or bowing very low.  E. नम् to bow, intens. form, शानच् aff.
नपुंसक: नपुंसक mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. A eunuch. 	 2. An impotent or imbecile man. 	 3. The neuter gender.  E. न not. पुंसक male.
नप्तृ: नप्तृ m. (-प्ता) A grandson. 	 f. (-प्त्री) A grand daughter.  E. न not, पत् to fall, तृच् Unādi affix; propping or sustaining the family.
नभ: नभ m. (-भः) 	 1. The month Srāvana. 	 2. Æther, atmosphere. 	 f. (-भा) 	 1. A spitting pot. 	 2. The city of the sun.  E. नह् to bind, affix भ; see नभस ।
नभःक्रान्तिन्: नभःक्रान्तिन् m. (-न्ती) A lion.  E. नभस् a cloud, and क्रान्तिन् who goes; whose shape is seen in the clouds.

नभःसरित्: नभःसरित् f. (-रित्) The celestial Ganges.  E. नभस् heaven, and सरित् a river.

नभःस्थित: नभःस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abiding in heaven or in the sky. 	 m. (-तः) A division of the infernal regions, a hell.  E. नभस् atmosphere, and स्थित a staying; also नभस्स्थित ।
नभश्चक्षुस्: नभश्चक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) The sun.  E. नभस् heaven, and चक्षुस् the eye.

(-भः) sky, atmosphere, ether or heaven.  E. नभ् to injure, to be annihilated, (at the end of the world,) Unādi affix असुन्, or नह् to bind, and भ substituted for ह.

नभोम्बुप: नभोऽम्बुप m. (-पः) The Chātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.)  E. नभस् sky, अम्बु water, and प who drinks.
नभोरजस: नभोरजस n. (-जः) Darkness.  E. नभस् sky, and रजस् dust.
नभोरेणु: नभोरेणु f. (-णुः) Fog, mist, vapour.  E. नभस् sky, and रेणु thin dust.
नभोलय: नभोलय m. (-यः) Smoke.  E. नभस् sky, and लय abode.
नभोलिह्: नभोलिह् mfn. (-लिट्) Lofty, towering, rising to the clouds.  E. नभस्, and लिह् what touches.
नभ्य: नभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Relating to the nave of a wheel, resembling it, &c.  E. नभ for नाभि, and यत् aff.
नभ्राज्: नभ्राज् m. (-भ्राट्) A cloud.  E. न negative, भ्राज् to shine, affix क्विप् ।
नम: नम r. 1st cl. (नमति) To bow, to pay obeisance. r. 10th cl. (नमयति-नामयति) To bend, to bow: see णम ।
नमत्: नमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) Bending, stooping, bowed.  E. नम् to bow, शतृ aff.
नमत: नमत m. (-तः) 	 1. A master, a lord. 	 2. An actor, a mime. 	 3. A cloud. E. नम to bow or bend, Unādi affix कर्मणि अतच् ।
नमयत्: नमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Bending, directing downward, declining. E. नम् to bow. r. 10th cl. शतृ aff.
नमस्: नमस् ind. 	 1. Gift, present. 	 2. Bowing, bending, salutation, obeisance. 3. An inarticulate cry. 	 4. The term used in connexion with the name of a deity in the fifth case to signify veneration, as रामाय नमः salutation, glory or reverence to RĀMA.  E. नम् to bend, and affix असुन-सच् ।
नमस: नमस m. (-सः) Agreement, concord.  E. नम् to bow, affix असच् । अनुकूले च ।
नमसित: नमसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reverenced, respected, worshipped.  E. नमस् bowing, क्यप् affix, and क्त added, य rejected: see नमस्यित ।
नमस्कार: नमस्कार m. (-रः) 	 1. Respectful or reverential address or salutation. 	 2. A sort of poison. 	 f. (-री) A sensitive plant.  E. नमस् bowing, and कार making, fem. affix अच० गौरा० ङीष्; or नमस् + कृ + घञ् ।
नमस्कत्वा: नमस्कत्वा ind. Having saluted reverentially.  E. नमस्, and कृत्वा having made.
नमस्य: नमस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Venerable, respectable, entitled to salutation or civility. 	 f. (-स्या) Reverence, respect, worship, adoration.  E. नमस् respect, क्यच् aff or नामधातुः नमस्य कर्मणि यत् अल्लोपयल्लोपौ ।
नमस्यत्: नमस्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) Saluting reverentially, bowing to, paying adoration.  E. नमस् nominal verb, to bow, शतृ aff.
नमस्यित: नमस्यित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reverenced, respected. worshipped.  E. नमस् res-pect, affix क्यप्, and the participial affix क्त; also नमसित ।
नमित: नमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bowed, making salutation or obeisance. 	 2. Bowed, bent down.  E. नम् to bend, causal form, affix णिच् क्त वा ह्रस्वः ।
नमुचि: नमुचि m. (-चिः) 	 1. The deity of love. 	 2. A demon so named.  E. न nega-tive, मुच् to loose, and कि aff.
नमुचिमूदन: नमुचिमूदन m. (-नः) A name of INDRA.  E. नमुचि the demon, and सूदन des-troyer; also similar names, as नमुचिद्विष्, &c. नमुचिं सूदयति हिनस्ति सूदि-ल्यु ।
नमेरु: नमेरु m. (-रुः) The seed of the Elæocarpus.  E. न not, मेरु the mountain Meru. or नम वा एरु ।
नमोगुरु: नमोगुरु m. (-रुः) A spiritual teacher.  E. नमस् reverence, and गुरु a teacher.
नम्ब: नम्ब r. 1st cl. (नम्बति) To go, to move.
नम्र: नम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) Crooked, curved, bent, bowed.  E. नम् to bow, affix र.
नम्रक: नम्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Bent or bowed, stooping.  E. कत् added to the last. नम्र इव कायति कै-क ।
नम्रमुख: नम्रमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Looking down, having the head bent.  E. नम्र, and मुख the face.
नम्रमूर्ति: नम्रमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Bending down, stooping, bowed,  E. नम्र, and मूर्त्ति form.
नम्रमूर्त्ति: नम्रमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Bending down, stooping, bowed,  E. नम्र, and मूर्त्ति form.
नम्राङ्ग: नम्राङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Bent, bowed, stooping.  E. नम्र, and अङ्ग the body.
नय: नय r. 1st cl. (नयते) To go, to move: see णय and णी । भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् ।

नय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Fit, right, proper. 	 2. Leading, conducting, (who or what does so.) 	 m. (यः) 	 1. Guiding, directing, (literally or figura-tively, as in morals, &c.) 	 2. Polity, civil and military government. 3. The theological part of the Vedas. 	 4. A sort of dice or men for playing with. 	 5. A guide, a conductor.  E. नय् to go, affix घञ्, or णी to guide, &c. affix भावे अच् ।
नयत्: नयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Leading, guiding. 	 2. Tending or conducing to. 	 3. Informing, certifying, giving in evidence. 	 4. Obtaining.  E. णी to obtain, शतृ aff.
नयन: नयन n. (-नं) 	 1. The eye. 	 2. Leading, guiding, (literally or figuratively.) 3. Attaining, obtaining. 	 4. Bringing. 	 f. (-ना) The pupil of the eye. E. णी to guide, affix करणे ल्युट् । नीयते वुद्धि वृत्तिः स्वसंयुक्तविषयान् अनेन ।
नयनवारि: नयनवारि n. (-रि) Tears.  E. नयन, and वारि water.
नयनामोषिन्: नयनामोषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Sight-stealing, blinding.  E. नयन, and आमोषिन् what steals.
नयनोत्सव: नयनोत्सव m. (-वः) 	 1. A lamp. 	 2. Any lovely or desired object.  E. नयन the eye, and उत्सव a festival.
नयनोपान्त: नयनोपान्त m. (-न्तः) The outer angle or canthus of the eye.  E. नयन, and उपान्त extremity. अपाङ्गे ।
नयनौषध: नयनौषध m. (-धः) Green sulphate of iron, or the salt in a state of par-tial decomposition by exposure to the atmosphere.  E. नयन the eye, and औषध a medicament, being used as a collyrium. पुष्पकासीसे ।
नयपीठी: नयपीठी f. (-ठी) The board or cloth on which dice are played. E. नय dice, पीठी a stool. (छक् ।)
नयप्रयोग: नयप्रयोग m. (-गः) Policy, political address.  E. नय, and प्रयोग application.
नयविशारद: नयविशारद m. (-दः) A politician, a statesman.  E. नय, and विशारद skilled in.
नयसिद्धि: नयसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Political success, accomplishing any thing by good management.  E. नय, and सिद्धि success.
नर: नर m. (-रः) 	 1. Man, individually or generally. 	 2. The Eternal, the divine imperishable spirit pervading the universe. 	 3. A name of ARJUNA. 	 4. VISHṆU. 	 5. A gnomon. 	 6. A man or piece at chess, draughts, &c. 	 7. A Muni, an incarnation of VISHṆU. 	 n. (-रं) A fragrant grass, commonly Rāmkappur. 	 f. (-रौ) Woman in general: see नारी.  E. नॄ or नृ to lead or guide, affix नये-अच् । गणितशास्त्रोक्ते छायाप्रमाण ज्ञानोपयोगिनि शङ्कौ च ।
नरक: नरक mn. (-कः-कं) Hell, the infernal regions, including a number of places of torture of various descriptions. 	 m. (-कः) The name of a Daitya or demon.  E. नृ to guide or lead, affix वुन्, whither the wicked are conducted: It is sometimes read नारक ।
नरककुण्ड: नरककुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A well or pit in Tartarus, eighty-six such are enu-merated.  E. नरक, and कुण्ड a pit.
नरकजित्: नरकजित् m. (-जित्) A name of VISHṆU.  E. नरक tke demon, and जित् subduing. नरकम् असुरभेदं जयति स्म । जि-भूते क्विप् ६ त० स० ।
नरकदेवता: नरकदेवता f. (-ता) Misfortune, personified as a goddess.  E. नरक, and देवता divinity. निऋतौ ।
नरकस्थ: नरकस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Living or being in Tartarus, who or what is there. 	 f. (-स्था) The river of hell named “Baitarany”.  E. नरक hell, स्थ who stays or abides, fem. affix टाप् ।
नरकान्तक: नरकान्तक m. (-कः) VISHṆU.  E. नरक hell, and अन्तक destroyer.
नरकामय: नरकामय m. (-यः) The soul after death.  E. नरक hell, and आमय sickness.
नरकीलक: नरकीलक m. (-कः) The murderer of his spiritual preceptor.  E. नर man-kind, and कील a stake, affix कन् ।
नरङ्ग: नरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Pimples of the face. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) The penis.  E. नृ to guide or lead, Unādi affix अङ्गच्.
नरदेव: नरदेव m. (-वः) A sovereign, a king.  E. नर a man, and देव a deity,
नरनारायण: नरनारायण m. dual. (-णौ) Two sages, incarnations of VISHṆU, and born again, as KRISHṆA and ARJUNA.  E. नर, and नारायण, each severally the name of a sage.
नरपति: नरपति m. (-तिः) A king, a sovereign, a prince.  E. नर man, पति lord.
नरप्रिय: नरप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Favourable or friendly to mankind.  E. नर, and प्रिय fond of. नीलवृक्षे च ।
नरभू: नरभू f. (-भूः) Bhārata Varsha, India, or the central of the known conti-nent. 	 2. The birth or birthplace of men.  E. नर man, and भू land; also नरभूमि f. (-मिः)
नरमानिनी: नरमानिनी f. (-नी) A woman who has a beard.  E. नर a man, मन् to re-gard or think, and णिनि affix; also with कन् affix in the feminine form, नरमानिका; these words are also written नरमालिनी, &c. नरं मन्यते मन-णिनि-ङीप् ।
नरमाला: नरमाला f. (-ला) A string or girdle of skulls.  E. नर, and माला a garland.
नरमालिनी: नरमालिनी f. (-नी) A woman with a beard.  E. नर a man, माला a necklace, इनि aff.
नरमेध: नरमेध m. (-धः) A human sacrifice.  E. नर, and मेध a sacrifice. मिध आधारे घञ् ।
नरवाहन: नरवाहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Borne or carried by men. 	 m. (-नः) A name of KUVERA.  E. नर a man, and वाहन a vehicle.
नरवाहिन्: नरवाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Carried by men, (a vehicle.)  E. नर, and वाहिन् what bears.
नरविष्वण: नरविष्वण m. (-णः) An imp or goblin.  E. नर man, विष्वण who devours.
नररूप: नररूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Having the form of man. 	 n. (-पं) The human form. E. नर, and रुप form.
नररूपिन्: नररूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Having the human form.  E. नररूप, and इनि aff.
नरसिंह: नरसिंह m. (-हः) VISHṆU in his fourth Avatār or descent, the lion-headed man. 	 2. A chief, a man of eminence or power.  E. नर a man and सिंह a lion.
नरहरि: नरहरि m. (-रिः) VISHṆU in his fourth Avatār. see the last.  E. नर, and हरि a lion.
नराधम: नराधम m. (-मः) A low or vile man, a wretch.  E. नर, and अधम low.
नराधारा: नराधारा f. (-रा) The earth.  E. नर man, आधार receptacle.
नराधिप: नराधिप m. (-पः) A king.  E. नर and अधिप ruler.
नरान्तक: नरान्तक m. (-कः) 	 1. Death. 	 2. A Rākshasa, a son of RĀVANA.  E. नर, and अन्तक destroyer.
नरायण: नरायण m. (-णः) A name of VISHṆU.  E. नर man, and अयण going; see नारायण ।
नरेन्द्र: नरेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 	 1. A king, an anointed sovereign. 	 2. A dealer in anti-dotes, a juggler.  E. नर a man, इन्द्र chief.
नरेश: नरेश m. (-शः) A king.  E. नर, and ईश master.
नरेश्वर: नरेश्वर m. (-रः) A king.  E. नर, and ईश्वर a sovereign.

नर्त्तन: नर्त्तन n. (-नं) Dancing, gesticulating, acting.  E. नृत् to dance, &c. affix भावे ल्युट् ।
नर्तनप्रिय: नर्त्तनप्रिय m. (-यः) A peacock.  E. नर्त्तन dancing, and प्रिय fond of.

नर्मठ: नर्म्मठ m. (-ठः) 	 1. The nipple. 	 2. A rake, a lecher, a libertine. 	 3. Sport, amusement. 	 4. Coition.  E. नर्म्म pleasure, स्था to abide, ड affix, deriv. irr. or नर्मणि कुशलः नर्मन् + अठन ।

नर्म्मद: नर्म्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Delighting, making happy, giving pleasure. 	 m. (-दः) The associate or companion of a person's sports or amuse-ments. 	 f. (-दा) 	 1. नर्मद्युति: नर्म्मद्युति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Happy, merry. 	 f. (-तिः) Enjoyment of a joke or any amusement.  E. नर्म्म, and द्युति lustre.
नर्म्मद्युति: नर्म्मद्युति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Happy, merry. 	 f. (-तिः) Enjoyment of a joke or any amusement.  E. नर्म्म, and द्युति lustre.
नर्मन्: नर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 	 1. Sport, amusement, pastime, diversion. 	 2. Jest, joke. 3. Wit, humour.  E. नृ to guide, affix मनिन् ।
नर्म्मन्: नर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 	 1. Sport, amusement, pastime, diversion. 	 2. Jest, joke. 3. Wit, humour.  E. नृ to guide, affix मनिन् ।
नर्मसचिव: नर्म्मसचिव m. (-वः) A companion, an associate, the promoter and parta-ker of a person's amusements, especially of a prince or man of rank.  E. नर्म्मन, and सचिव a minister.
नर्म्मसचिव: नर्म्मसचिव m. (-वः) A companion, an associate, the promoter and parta-ker of a person's amusements, especially of a prince or man of rank.  E. नर्म्मन, and सचिव a minister.
नर्मसाचिव्य: नर्म्मसाचिव्य n. (-व्यं) Superintendance or provision of a prince's amuse-ments, partaking a person's amusements.  E. नर्म्मसाचिव, and ष्यञ् aff.
नर्म्मसाचिव्य: नर्म्मसाचिव्य n. (-व्यं) Superintendance or provision of a prince's amuse-ments, partaking a person's amusements.  E. नर्म्मसाचिव, and ष्यञ् aff.
नर्मस्फूर्ज: नर्म्मस्फूर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) Happiness or amusement ending in alarm.  E. नर्म्म, and स्फूर्ज्ज thundering.
नर्म्मस्फूर्ज्ज: नर्म्मस्फूर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) Happiness or amusement ending in alarm.  E. नर्म्म, and स्फूर्ज्ज thundering.
नर्मस्फोट: नर्म्मस्फोट m. (-टः) Slight or inferior amusement.  E. नर्म्म, and स्फोट opening.
नर्म्मस्फोट: नर्म्मस्फोट m. (-टः) Slight or inferior amusement.  E. नर्म्म, and स्फोट opening.
नल: नल r. 10th cl. (नालयति) 	 1. To shine. 	 2. To bind or confine.

नल r. 10th cl. (-लः) 	 1. A reed, (Arundo karka, Rox.) 	 2. The name of a king, son of NISHADHA, and hero of several poetical works famous amongst the Hindus, especially the poem called Naishadha. 	 3. Another prince, the son of VĪRASENA. 	 4. A deified progenitor or Pitrideva. 	 5. The name of a monkey chief. 	 6. A demon. 	 f. (-ली) Red arsenic. 	 2. A perfume, commonly called by the same name of Nali. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. The water lily, (Nelumbium speciosum.) 	 2. Smell, odour.  E. नल् to shine, affix अच् ।
नलक: नलक n. (-कं) A bone of either of the extremities, any long bone. E. नल a reed, and कन् affix of resemblance.
नलकिनी: नलकिनी f. (-नी) The knee cap or pan.  E. नलक as above, and इनि affix; connecting the bones of the lower extremity.
नलकील: नलकील m. (-लः) The knee.  E. नल a reed, or reed-like bone, and कील a pin or bolt.
नलकूवर: नलकूवर m. (-रः) The son of KUVERA.  E. नल a reed, कूवर a carriage yoke.
नलद: नलद n. (-दं) Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 	 f. (-दा) 	 1. The honey or nectar of a flower. 	 2. The root of the Andropogon muri-catum.  E. नल here said to mean, fragrance, and द what gives.
नलपट्टिका: नलपट्टिका f. (-का) A sort of mat made with reeds, a coarse mat.  E. नल a reed, and पट्ट a cloth, कन् affix of similitude.
नलमीन: नलमीन m. (-नः) A kind of sprat of according to some, a shrimp or prawn.  E. नल a reed, and मोन a fish; frequenting reedy spots. See नडमीन ।
नलिका: नलिका f. (-का) A perfume: see नली.  E. नली, and कन् added.
नलिन: नलिन n. (-नं) 	 1. A lotus or water lily, (Nelumbium speciosum, or Nym-phæa nelumbo.) 	 2. Water. 	 3. Indigo. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. The Indian crane. 2. A small fruit, Karonda. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. An assemblage of lotus flowers. 	 2. A place abounding in lotuses. 	 3. The flexible stalk of a water lily. 	 4. A pond in which the lotus grows or may grow. 	 5. The Ganges of heaven. 	 6. The fermented and intoxicating juice of the cocoanut.  E. नल् to be bright, Unādi affix इनन् ।
नलिनीरुह: नलिनीरुह m. (-हः) 	 1. BRAMHĀ. 	 2. n. (-हं) The fibres of the lotus stalk. E. नलिनी, and रुह what grows and क affix.
नलिनेशय: नलिनेशय m. (-यः) A name of VISHṆU.  E. नलिने in a lotus, and शय who sleeps. नलिने व्रह्मनाभिकमले शेते शी-अच् । अलुक़् स० ।
नल्व: नल्व m. (-ल्वः) A furlong, a distance measured by four hundred cubits. E. नल् to be as a reed in length, and व aff.
नल्ववर्त्मगा: नल्ववर्त्मगा f. (-गा) The orange tree.  E. नल्व as above, वर्त्म a road, and ग what goes.
नव: नव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) New. 	 m. (-वः) Praise, panegyric, celebration.  E. नु to praise, &c. affix. कर्मणि भावे वा अप् ।
नवकारिक: नवकारिक f. (-का) 	 1. A bride, a woman newly married. 	 2. A new com-ment.  E. नव new, and कारिका agent.
नवकालिका: नवकालिका f. (-का) A young woman, either one recently married or one in whom menstruation has lately commenced.  E. नव new, काल time, कन् added with the fem. form.
नवग्रहा: नवग्रहा m. plu. (-हाः) The nine planets, or sun, moon, five planets, and the ascending and descending nodes.  E. नव for नवन्, and ग्रह a planet.
नवच्छात्र: नवछात्र m. (-त्रः) A student, a novice.  E. नव new, and छात्र a disciple.
नवछात्र: नवछात्र m. (-त्रः) A student, a novice.  E. नव new, and छात्र a disciple.
नवत: नवत m. (-तः) An elephant's painted or variegated housings.  E. नव new, तन् to spread, affix ङ or नू-अतच् ।
नवता: नवता f. (-ता) Novelty.  E. तल् added to नव; also with त्व, नवत्वं;
नवति: नवति f. (-ति or -ती) Ninety.  E. नव nine, and क्तिन् aff.
नवतिका: नवतिका f. (-का) A painting brush.  E. नवति ninety, (hairs,) कन् aff.
नवतिधा: नवतिधा ind. Ninety-fold.  E. नवति, and धा aff.
नवतिशस्: नवतिशस् ind. Ninety by ninety.  E. नवति, and शस् aff.
नवदल: नवदल n. (-लं) 	 1. The new leaf of a lotus. 	 2. Any young leaf.  E. नव new, and दल a leaf.
नवदीधिति: नवदीधिति m. (-तिः) Mars, the planet or its deified regent.  E. नव nine, दोधिति a ray.
नवदुर्गा: नवदुर्गा f. (-र्गा) The nine forms of DURGĀ.  E. नव, and दुर्गा the goddess.
नवदोला: नवदोला f. (-ला) A litter borne by nine men.  E. नव, and दोल a litter.
नवद्वार: नवद्वार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having nine doors; an epithet applied to the body, which has nine inlets or outlets, as the nostrils, ears, mouth, &c.  E. नव, and द्वार a door.
नवधा: नवधा ind. Nine-fold, in nine ways.  E. नव nine, and धा aff.
नवनीत: नवनीत n. (-तं) Fresh butter.  E. नव new, and नीत procured from milk, &c.)
नवनीतक: नवनीतक n. (-कं) Clarified butter.  E. कन् added to the last.
नवनीतधेनु: नवनीतधेनु f. (-नुः) A quantity of butter as a present to Brāhmans. E. नवनीत, and धेनु a milch cow.
नवपल्लव: नवपल्लव n. (-वं) A new shoot or sprout.  E. नव, and पल्लव a shoot.
नवफलिका: नवफलिका f. (-का) 	 1. A bride, a newly married woman. 	 2. A girl in whom menstruation has recently begun.  E. नव new, फल fruit, and ठक् aff.
नवब: नवब(व)धू f. (-धूः) A bride, a newly married woman.  E. नव, and बधू a wife.
नवम: नवम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Ninth. 	 f. (-मी) The ninth day of a lunar half month.  E. नव nine, and डढि-मट् aff.
नवमल्लिका: नवमल्लिका f. (-का) Double jasmine: see the next.
नवमालिका: नवमालिका f. (-का) Double jasmine, (J. Zambac.)  E. नव excellent, praised, and मालिका or मल्लिका jasmine: see the last.
नवयौवना: नवयौवना f. (-ना) A young woman.  E. नव new, and यौवन young.
नवरक्तक: नवरक्तक n. (-कं) A newly dyed garment.  E. नव, रक्त red, and कन् aff.
नवरङ्ग: नवरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Gift to five and acceptance by fours persons of the best Kayastha families.  E. नव, and रङ्ग colour.
नवरत्र: नवरत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Nine precious gems, or a pearl, ruby, topaz, diamond, emerald, lapis lazuli, coral, sapphire, and one called Gomedā. 	 2. The nine men of letters at the court of VIKRAMĀDITYA, or DHAN-WANTARI, KSHAPANAKA, AMARASINHA, SANKU, VETĀLABHATTA, GHATAKARPARA, KĀLIDĀSA, VARĀHAMIHIRA, and VARARŪCHI. E. नव and रत्र a jewel.
नवरात्र: नवरात्र n. (-त्रं) The period of nine days, from the first of the light half of Aswin to the ninth; part of the time devoted to the worship of DURGĀ.  E. नव, and रात्रि a night.
नववरिका: नववरिका f. (-का) A newly married woman.  E. नव new, वर a blessing, affix कन् added, fem. affix टाप् ।
नववस्त्र: नववस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) New cloth.  E. नव, new, and वस्त्र cloth.
नवशस्: नवशस् ind. Nine by nine.  E. नव, and शस् aff.
नवशस्य: नवशस्य n. (-स्य) Grain of the year's harvest.  E. नव, and शस्य grain.
नवशस्येष्टि: नवशस्येष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A sacrifice performed on eating the new rice or grain of the year, नवशस्य, and इष्टि sacrifice.
नवशायक: नवशायक m. (-कः) A name given to any of nine inferior classes, the cowherd, gardener, oilman, weaver, confectioner, betel seller, potter, blacksmith, and barber.
नवश्राद्ध: नवश्राद्ध n. (-द्धं) The first series of Shrāddhas collectively, or funeral offer-ings on the first, third, fifth, seventh, ninth, and eleventh days after a person's demise.  E. नव, and श्राद्ध obsequial rite.
नधसूतिका: नधसूतिका f. (-का) 	 1. A milch cow. 	 2. A woman recently delivered. E. नव new, and सूत offspring, and कन् affix, fem. form.
नवांश: नवांश m. (-शः) A ninth, a ninth part.  E. नव, and अंश share,
नवान्न: नवान्न n. (-न्नं) 	 1. New rice or grain. 	 2. A ceremony observed on first eating the rice, &c. of the last harvest.  E. नव, and अन्न food.
नवाम्बर: नवाम्बर n. (-रं) New and unbleached cloth.  E. नव new, and अम्बर cloth.
नवार्चिस्: नवार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet Mars or its deified personification.  E. नव nine, and अर्च्चिस् light.
नवार्च्चिस्: नवार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet Mars or its deified personification.  E. नव nine, and अर्च्चिस् light.
नवाह: नवाह m. (-हः) 	 1. A new day. 	 2. The first day of the fortnight.  E. नव new, and अह a day.
नवीकरण: नवीकरण n. (-णं) Renewing, doing or making anew,  E. नव, करण making, च्वि augment.
नवीकृत: नवीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Renewed, revived, done or made anew,  E. नव, and कृत made, च्वि augment.
नवीन: नवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) New.  E. नव new, ख pleonasm, and the semi-vowel changed.
नवीभूत: नवीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Renewed, revived.  E. नव, and, भूत become, च्वि augment.
नवै: नवै ind. Not so perhaps, a particle implying doubt.  E. न not, वै expletive.
नवोढा: नवोढा f. (-ढा) A newly married woman, a bride.  E. नव new, and ऊढा a wife.
नवोद्धृत: नवोद्धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Newly extracted or drawn up. 	 n. (-तं) 	 2. Fresh butter.  E. नव new, उद्धृत made or drawn up.
नव्य: नव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) New, recent, young, modern. &c. 	 m. (-व्यः) Praise, panegyric.  E. नव new, and स्वार्थे यत् aff. रक्तपुनर्नवायाम् च ।
नशाक: नशाक mf. (-कः-का) A bird, said to be a sort of crow.  E. नश् to destroy, affix आक ।
नशितृ: नशितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Destroying.  E. णश to destroy, affix तृच् with इट् augment, else with a nasal augment नष्टृ ।
नश्यत्: नश्यत् mfn. (श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) Perishing, decaying, wasting, being destroy-ed.  E. नश् to perish, and शतृ aff.
नश्यत्प्रसूतिका: नश्यत्प्रसूतिका f. (-का) A female bearing a dead child.  E. नश्यत्, प्रसूतिका a mother.
नश्वर: नश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Mischievous. 	 2. Destructive, perishable.  E. णशि to destroy, affix छरप् ।
नष्ट: नष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Lost, destroyed, removed, annihilated.  E. णश to perish, affix क्त ।
नष्टचन्द्र: नष्टचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The moon on the fourth lunation of either half of Bhādra.  E. नष्ट, and चन्द्र the moon: it is is very unlucky to see the moon on these days.
नष्टचेतन: नष्टचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fainted, insensible.  E. नष्ट, and चेतन conscious.
नष्टचेष्ट: नष्टचेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Insensible, inert.  E. नष्ट, and चेष्टा effort.
नष्टचेष्टता: नष्टचेष्टता f. (-ता) Fainting, swooning, insensibility, proceeding either from joy or sorrow, &c.  E. नष्ट lost, चेष्टता effort. हर्षशोकादिभिः सर्व-चेष्टाराहित्ये ।
नष्टसंस्मृति: नष्टसंस्मृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Unmindful, forgetful.  E. नष्ट, and संस्मृति recollection.
नष्टाग्नि: नष्टाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A Brāhman or householder who has lost his conse-crated fire.  E. नष्ट lost, and अग्नि fire.
नष्टाप्तिसूत्र: नष्टाप्तिसूत्र n. (-त्रं) Booty, plunder.  E. नष्ट lost, आप्ति gain, and सूत्र thread or chain.
नष्टार्थ: नष्टार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Reduced, become poor.  E. नष्ट, and अर्थ wealth.
नष्टेन्दुकला: नष्टेन्दुकला f. (-ला) The day of new moon when it rises invisible.  E. नष्ट, and इन्दुकला a digit.
नस्: नस् f. (-नाः) The nose.  E. नस् to sound, affix क्विप् ।
नसा: नसा f. (-सा) The nose: see नासा and नासिका ।
नस्त: नस्त m. (-स्तः) The nose. 	 n. (-स्तं) A sternutatory, snuff, &c. 	 f. (-स्ता) A hole bored in the septum of the nose.  E. णस् to make crooked, affix संज्ञायां त ।
नस्तित: नस्तित m. (-तः) An ox or any other draft animal, with a string through his nose, the sort of rein usually employed in India. 	 f. (-ता) Nozzled.  E. नस्त as above, the nose, formed into a nominal verb, and क्त added, nozzled or nose-led. णस्-तार-इतच् । (नाकफोडा) ।
नस्तोत: नस्तोत mf. (-तः) An ox led by a string through his nose: see the last; also नस्योत. नसि नासिकायां सम्यक् ऊतः आ + वे-क्त ।
नस्य: नस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Nasal, relating or belonging to the nose. 	 n. (-स्यं) A sternutatory, snuff. 	 f. (-स्या) The nose.  E. नसा the nose, यत् aff.
नस्योत: नस्योत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) An ox or other animal led by a string through the septum of the nose.  E. नसा the nose, यत् affix of relation or fitness, and ऊत woven: see नस्तित । आ + वे + क्त ।
नह: नह (-औ) औनह r. 4th cl. (नह्यति-ते) To bind: see णह ।
नहि: नहि ind. No, not.  E. णह् to bind or tie, affix इन् ।
नहुष: नहुष m. (-षः) 	 1. The name of a Nāga or serpent. 	 2. The name of a king, one of the lunar race, son of AYUS and grandson of PURŪ-RAVAS.  E. णह् to bind, Unādi affix उषन्.
नहुषात्मज: नहुषात्मज m. (-जः) A king, also YAYĀTI.  E. नहुष as above, आत्मज son.
ना: ना ind. No, not (another form of न ।)
नाक: नाक m. (-कः) Heaven, paradise, æther. sky, atmosphere.  E. न not with अक derived from क happiness, and the privative अ prefixed misery; in which there is no unhappiness. न कम् अकम् दुःखम् तत् नास्ति यत्र ।
नाकनाथ: नाकनाथ m. (-थः) A name of INDRA.  E. नाक paradise, and नाथ lord; also with कन् added नाकनाथक ।
नाकनायक: नाकनायक m. (-कः) INDRA.  E. नाक, and नायक a chief.
नाकवनिता: नाकवनिता f. (-ता) A nymph of heaven.  E. नाक, and वनिता a wife.
नाकसद्: नाकसद् m. (-सत्) A deity.  E. नाक, and सद् who dwells in.
नाकिन्: नाकिन् m. (-की) A deity, a god.  E. नाक heaven, and इनि aff.
नाकु: नाकु m. (-कुः) 	 1. An ant or mole hill, a burrow. 	 2. A mountain. 	 3. A name of a Muni or saint.  E. न privative, अक् to go, affix उ, or नम् to be crooked or bowed, Unādi affix उ, and नाक substituted for the radical letters.
नाकुल: नाकुल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Relating or belonging to an ichneumon. 	 f. (-ली) 1. A plant; the ichneumon plant, a vegetable supposed to furnish the mungoose with an antidote, when bitten in a conflict with a snake, (Serpent ophioxylon) 	 2. The root of the Simul tree, (कुक्कुटोकन्द) A sort of pepper, (Piper chavya)  E. नकुल the ichneu-mon, affixes अण् and ङीष् । चविके, (चै) राम्नायां, यवतिक्तायां, श्वेत-कण्टकार्य्यां च ।
नाकुलान्ध्य: नाकुलान्ध्य n. (-न्धं) Weakness of sight  E. नाकुल, and अन्ध्य blindness.
नाकुसद्मन्: नाकुसद्मन् m. (-द्मा) A snake.  E. नाकु a mound of earth, सद्मन् a dwelling.
नाक्षत्र: नाक्षत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Relating or belonging to the luner asterisms. 	 n. (-त्रं) A month, one computed by the moon's passage through the twenty-seven mansions, or of thirty days of sixty Gharis each. E. नक्षत्र, and अण् aff.
नाक्षत्रिक: नाक्षत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to the lunar asterisms. m. (-कः) A month of twenty-seven days, each day being the period of the moon's passage through a luner asterism, f. (-की) The state or condition to which a person is subjected agreeably to the asterism presiding over his nativity.  E. नक्षत्र as above, and ठञ् aff.
नाग: नाग m. (-गः) Nāga or demi-god so called, having a human face, with the tail of a serpent, and the expanded neck of the Koluber Nāga; the race of these beings is said to have sprung from KADRU, the the wife of KĀSYAPA, in order to people Pātāla or the regions below the earth. 	 2. A serpent in general or especially the specta-cle snake, or cobra capella, (Coluber Nāga.) 	 3. An elephant. 	 4. A cruel or tyrannical person. 	 5. A cloud. 	 6. (In composition,) Pre-eminent. 	 7. A pin or nail projecting from a wall to hang any thing upon. 	 8. A small tree, (Mesua ferrea.) 	 9. A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) 	 10. A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 11. One of the airs of the body, that which is expelled by belching. 12. Betel or Pān. 	 13. The name of a country. 	 14. A shark. 	 n. (-गं) 	 1. Tin. 	 2. Lead. 	 3. One of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas; it is one of those termed invariable, and always corresponds to the last half of Āmavasya or new moon. 	 4. The effects of that period on any thing done or happening during it.  E. नग a moun-tain, and अण् affix; living or produced in mountainous regions, &c. नगे पर्वते भवः अण् न गच्छति अगः न अगो वा ।
नागकेशर: नागकेशर m. (-रः) A small tree, commonly Nageshwar, (Mesua ferrea). E. नाग, and केशर synonymes of the same plant compounded; the word is also written नागकेसर.
नागगर्भ: नागगर्भ n. (-भं) Red lead.  E. नाग lead. and गर्भ origin. सिन्दुरे ।
नागज: नागज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by or of a Nāga. &c. 	 n. (-जं) 	 1. Red lead. 	 2. Tin.  E. नाग lead, &c. and ज produced.
नागजिह्वा: नागजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa:) see शारिवा  E. नाग a snake, and जिह्वा a tongue.
नागजिह्विका: नागजिह्विका f. (-का) Red arsenic.  E. नाग a snake, जिह्वा a tongue, कन् affix of comparison. मनःशिलायाम् ।
नागजीवन: नागजीवन m. (-नः) Tin.  E. नाग lead, जीवन proceeding.
नागदन्त: नागदन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. Elephant's tooth or ivory; also the tooth of the ele-phant. 	 2. A shelf, a pin or bracket projecting from a wall, and used to hang things upon. 	 f. (-न्ती) 	 1. A sort of sun-flower, (Helio-tropium Indicum.) 	 2. A whore.  E. नाग an elephant, and दन्त a tooth.
नागदन्तिक: नागदन्तिक m. (-कः) A wooden pin or bracket, projecting from a wall, a shelf.  E. नागदन्त an elephant's tooth, and कन् affix of resemblance.
नागदन्तिका: नागदन्तिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly called Rāmadūtī, see विशल्या । E. नागदन्ती a plant, and कन् affix of resemblance. (विछाति ।)
नागदलोपम: नागदलोपम m. (-मः) A sort of tree commonly Parusha.  E. नाग one of the plants so called, दल a leaf, and उपमा resemblance.
नागद्रु: नागद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Euphorbia  E. नाग a snake, and द्रु a tree; being used in offerings to the snake goddess MANASĀ. सि वृक्षे ।
नागनिर्यूह: नागनिर्य्यूह m. (-हः) A large pin or bracket, projecting from a wall like a shelf.  E. नाग an elephant, and निर्य्यूह projection.
नागनिर्य्यूह: नागनिर्य्यूह m. (-हः) A large pin or bracket, projecting from a wall like a shelf.  E. नाग an elephant, and निर्य्यूह projection.
नागपाश: नागपाश m. (-शः) 	 1. A weapon of VARUṆA the regent of water. 	 2. A sort of magical noose or knot, used in battle to entangle an enemy.  E. नाग an elephant, and पाश a binding.
नागपुष्प: नागपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 	 1. A tree in used in dyeing, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 	 2. Nāgeshwar, (Mesua ferrea.) 	 3. The Champaka, (Michelia champa-ca)  E. नाग an elephant, and पुष्प flower.
नागबन्धु: नागबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)  E. नाग an elephant and बन्धु friendly, liked.
नागबल: नागबल m. (-लः) A name of BHĪMA. 	 f. (-ला) A creeping plant, (Hedy-sarum lagopodioides.)  E. नाग an elephant, and बल strong. (गोरक्ष चाकुलिया ।)
नागभिद्: नागभिद् m. (-भिद्) A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.)  E. नाग an elephant, and भिद् destroying; the word is sometimes written नागभृत्, from भृत् cherishing.
नागमल्ल: नागमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) The elephant of INDRA.  E. नाग an elephant, and मल्ल a boxer.
नागमातृ: नागमातृ f. (-ता) 	 1. A name of MANASĀ, a goddess supposed to preside over snakes. 	 2. Red arsenic.  E. नाग a snake, and मातृ a mother.
नाममार: नाममार m. (-रः) A sort of potherb; also केशराज  E. नाग a snake, and मार destroying; considered as an antidote.
नागयष्टि: नागयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A piece of wood erected in a newly dug pond for showing the depth of water.  E. नाग a snake, and यष्टि a staff; also नागयष्टिका ।
नागर: नागर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Clever, sharp, knowing, (as a buck, a blood, a wag. &c.) 	 2. Town-born or bred, citizen. 	 3. Nameless. 	 4. Rela-ting to a city. 	 5. Polite, civil 6. Bad, vile. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. Dry ginger. 2. A short of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis). 	 3. A form of writing, the “Devanāgari alphabet.” m. (-रः) 	 1. A husband's brother. 	 2. An orange. 	 3. A lecturer. 	 4. Denial of knowledge. 	 5. Fatigue. 	 6. Desire of final beatitude. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. A sort of Euphorbia. 	 2. A clever or intriguing woman.  E. नगर a city अण् aff. नगरे भवः अण् ।
नागरक: नागरक m. (-कः) 	 1. The orange; see नागरङ्ग 2. A thief. 	 3. An artist. E. नागर, and वुञ् aff.
नागरक्त: नागरक्त m. (-क्तः) Red lead.  E. नाग mountain, and रक्त red. सिन्दुरे ।
नागरङ्ग: नागरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The orange; in India usually applied to the Sylhet orange, (Citrus aurantium.)  E. नाग an elephant, रङ्ग to be sick, affix घञ्; on which elephants feed till they become ill; or नाग red lead, and रङ्ग colour, of the colour of red lead. (नाराङ्गी नेवु ।)
नागराज: नागराज m. (-जः) ANANTA, the chief of the Nāgas.  E. नाग, and राज king.
नागरीट: नागरीट m. (-टः) A libertine, a debauchee, a rake, a blackguard. E. नागरी an intriguing woman, अट् to accompany, affix अच्, deriv. irr. or more appropriately नागरी-मेटति-इट-गतौ-क ।
नागरुक: नागरुक m. (-कः) The orange: see नागरङ्ग ।
नागरेणु: नागरेणु m. (-णुः) Red lead.  E. नाग, and रेणु oxid. सिन्दुरे ।
नागरेयक: नागरेयक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) City, citizen.  E. नगर a town, and ढकञ् aff.
नागलता: नागलता f. (-ता) The penis.  E. नाग a snake, and लता a creeper.
नागलोक: नागलोक m. (-कः) The Nāga regions below the earth.  E. नाग a Nāga, and लोक world.
नागवल्लिका: नागवल्लिका f. (-का) The betel plant: see the next.
नागवल्ली: नागवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The betel plant, (Peper betel.)  E. नाग the infernal Nāga, and वल्ली a creeper; the creeper of the lower regions; also with कन् added नागवल्लिका ।
नागवारिक: नागवारिक m. (-कः) Garuda, the bird of VISHNŪ. 	 2. A peacock. 	 3. A royal elephant. 	 4. An elephant driver or keeper. 	 5. The chief person in a court or assembly.  E. नाग an elephant, वृ to cherish, &c. affix ठक् ।
नागवीट: नागवीट m. (-टः) A rake: see नागरीट ।
नागवीथी: नागवीथी f. (-थी) The path of Airāvata, “the milky way.”  E. नाग the elephant, वीथी a road or path.
नागसम्भव: नागसम्भव n. (-वं) Minium or red lead.  E. नाग lead, and सम्भव pro-duction.
नागसुगन्धा: नागसुगन्धा f. (-न्धा) The ichneumon plant: see नाकुली.  E. नाग a snake, and सुगन्ध perfume.
नागाख्य: नागाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A plant: see नागकेसर.  E. नाग an elephant, and आख्या a name.
नागाञ्चला: नागाञ्चला f. (-ला) A stick or pole driven into a square piece of earth in the centre of a newly dug pond, a boring rod.  E. नाग a snake, and अञ्चला end of a garment; it is also written नागाञ्चना f. (-ना) see नागयष्टि ।
नागाधिप: नागाधिप m. (-पः) The great serpent ANANTA.  E. नाग a serpent, and अधिप a king.
नागान्तक: नागान्तक m. (-कः) Garuda, the bird and vehicle of VISHṆU.  E. नाग a snake, and अन्तक a destroyer; this and similar compounds are also applied to the “Ardea Argala,” the peacock, and other birds who are natural enemies of the serpent genus.
नागारूढ: नागारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mounted or riding upon an elephant.  E. नाग, and आरूढ mounted.
नागाशन: नागाशन m. (-नः) Garuda: see नागान्तक.  E. नाग a snake, and अशन food.
नागाह्व: नागाह्व n. (-ह्वं) Hastināpur or ancient Delhi.  E. नाग an elephant, and आह्वा a name.
नागोद: नागोद n. (-दं) Armour for the front or the belly.
नागोदर: नागोदर n. (-रं) A breast plate, a cuirass.
नाचिकेतु: नाचिकेतु m. (-तुः) A name of fire; also नाचिकेतः ।
नाट: नाट n. (-टं) 	 1. Dancing, acting. 	 2. The Carnatic.  E. नट् to dance, affix घञ् ।
नाटक: नाटक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) An actor, acting, dancing, &c. 	 m. (-कः) a play, a drama: the first of the ten species of dramatic compositions of the first order. 	 f. (-की) The court of INDRA.  E. नट् to act or per-form, ण्वुल् aff.
नाटकप्रपञ्च: नाटकप्रपञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) Course or arrangement of a drama.  E. नाटक, and प्रपञ्च extent.
नाटकीय: नाटकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dramatic.  E. नाटक, and छ aff.
नाटाम्र: नाटाम्र m. (-म्रः) The Water melon, (Cucurbita citrullus.)
नाटार: नाटार m. (-रः) The son of an actress.
नाटिका: नाटिका f. (-का) A short or light comedy, the first of the Uparūpakas or dramas of the second order.  E. नट् to dance, ण्वुल् aff.
नाटेय: नाटेय m. (-यः) The son of an actress.  E. नटी and ढक् aff.
नाटेर: नाटेर m. (-रः) The son of an actress or dancing girl.  E. नटी an actress, ढ्रक् aff.
नाट्य: नाट्य n. (-ट्यं) The science or art of dancing or acting, or the union of song, dance, and instrumental music.  E. नट् to dance, affix ण्यत् or ज्य, or नटानां कर्म ष्यञ् ।
नाट्यधर्म्मिक: नाट्यधर्म्मिक m. (-कः) Rules of dramatic representation.  E. नाट्य acting, धर्म्म rule, and ठक् aff.
नाट्यप्रिय: नाट्यप्रिय m. (-यः) A name of SIVA.  E. नाट्य dancing, and प्रिय fond of.
नाट्यशाला: नाट्यशाला f. (-ला) A theatre, a building for dramatic exhibitions; accor-ding to some it should be built near the gate of a palace.  E. नाठ्य and शाला a hall.
नाट्योक्ति: नाट्योक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Dramatic phraseology.  E. नाठ्य and उक्ति expression.
नाडि: नाडि f. (-डिः-डी) 	 1. The stalk or stem of any plant. 	 2. Any tubular, organ of the body, as an artery, a vein, an intestine, &c. 	 3. The hollow stalk of a lotus, &c. 	 4. A fistulous sore, a fistula, a sinus. 5. A sort of bent grass. 	 6. A juggling trick. 	 7. Deception. 	 8. An hour of twenty-four minutes. 	 9. Any pipe or tube. 	 10. The pulse, either at the hand or feet, &c.  E. नड् to fall off or from, affix अच् and इन् or ङीष् optionally added.
नाडिका: नाडिका f. (-का) An Indian hour, or twenty-four minutes.  E. नाडि the same, कन् pleonasm.
नाडिकेल: नाडिकेल m. (-लः) The cocoanut: see नारिकेल.
नाडिचीर: नाडिचीर n. (-रं) A small reed or tube round which the woof is wound; it is then used as a shuttle.  E. नाडि a tube, and चीर old cloth.
नाडिन्धम: नाडिन्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Terrifying. 	 2. Moving the intestines. 	 m. (-मः) A goldsmith.  E. नाडि a tube, a hollow bamboo, &c. and धम who blows, from ध्मा with खश् aff.
नाडिन्धय: नाडिन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Who or what drinks or sucks through a tube. E. नाडि a pipe, धे to drink, affix खश्.
नाडिपत्र: नाडिपत्र n. (-त्रं) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)  E. नाडि a tube, पत्र a leaf.
नाडिमण्डल: नाडिमण्डल m. (-लं) The celestial equator.  E. नाडि, and मण्डल a sphere.
नाडीकेल: नाडीकेल m. (-लः) The cocoanut: see नाडिकेल.
नाडीच: नाडीच n. (-चं) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)  E. नाडी a tube, चर् to go or grow, affix ड.
नाडीचरण: नाडीचरण m. (-णः) A bird in general.  E. नाडी a tube, चरण foot.
नाडीजङ्घ: नाडीजङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) 	 1. A crow. 	 2. The name of a holy teacher or saint. 	 3. The name of a fabulous crane.  E. नाडी a stalk, and जङ्घा a leg or thigh.
नाडीतरङ्ग: नाडीतरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A sort of poison: see काकोल. 	 2. An astrologer. 	 3. A ravisher, a debaucher.  E. नाडी an Indian hour, and तरङ्ग a wave; also नाडीतरङ्गक.
नाडीदेह: नाडीदेह m. (-हः) BHRINGI, one of SIVA'S followers.  E. नाडी a tube, and देह the body; as thin.
नाडीनक्षत्र: नाडीनक्षत्र n. (-त्रं) The planet of a person's nativity.  E. नाडी and नक्षत्र an asterism.
नाडीविग्रह: नाडीविग्रह m. (-हः) A name of BHRINGI, one of SIVA'S chief attendants. E. नाडी a pipe, and विग्रह the body; also नाडीदेह, &c.
नाडीव्रण: नाडीव्रण n. (-णं) An ulcer.  E. नाडी a sinus, and व्रण a sore. (नालीघा ।)
नाडीस्नेह: नाडीस्नेह m. (-हः) A name of BHRINGI: see नाडीदेह ।
नाणक: नाणक n. (-कं) A coin, or any thing struck or stamped with an impression.
नाणकपरीक्षा: नाणकपरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Assaying.  E. नाणक, and परीक्षा trial.
नाणकपरीक्षिन्: नाणकपरीक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) An assayer.  E. नाणक, and परीक्षिन् who tries.
नात्र: नात्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Praise, eulogium. 	 2. Surprise, wonder. 	 m. (-त्रः) 	 1. SIVA. 2. A sage.  E. नम् to bow, ष्ट्रण् affix, म is dropped, and the short radical vowel made long.
नाथ: नाथ (ऋ) नाथृ r. 1st cl. (नाथति-ते) 	 1. To ask or beg. 	 2. To bless. 	 3. To destroy. 	 4. To have wealth or power. 	 5. To be deceased. उपतापे पर० आशिषि आत्म० ऐश्ये अर्थने च पर० भ्वा० सक० सेट् ।

नाथ m. (-थः) 	 1. A master, a lord. 	 2. A name of SIVA, especially in the form of a Linga; it is usually compounded with some word relat-ing to the legendary history of the Linga, as Somanātha, the Linga set up by SOMA, &c. 	 3. A name adopted by a class of Yogis, as GORAKSHANĀTHA, &c. 	 4. A rope passed through the nose of a draft ox.  E. नाथ् to ask, (from whom,) and अच् aff.

नाव्य: नाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. Navigable. 	 2. Belonging to a boat. 	 n. (-व्यं) Newness, novelty.  E. नौ a boat or vessel, and यत् affix; or नव new, ष्यञ् aff. नावा तीर्य्यते असौ, नवस्य भावः वा ।
नाश: नाश m. (-शः) 	 1. Annihilation, loss, destruction, disappearance, ruin. 	 2. Death. 	 3. Flight, retreat. 	 4. Abandonment, desertion. (In Arith-metic.) 	 5. Elimination.  E. णश् to cease to be, affix भावे घञ्.
नाशन: नाशन n. (-नं) 	 1. Destruction, perishing. 	 2. Removal, expulsion.  E. णश् to perish, affix णिच्. ल्युट्.
नाशयत्: नाशयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) destroying annihilating.  E. णश् to perish, causal form, शतृ aff.
नाशित: नाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Destroyed.  E. नश् to perish, causal form. क्त aff.
नाशिन्: नाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 	 1. Destructive, destroying, a destroyer. 	 2. Perishing, being lost or destroyed.  E. नश् to cease to be, in the causal from, affix इनि; or नाश, and इनि aff.
नाष्टिक: नाष्टिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to any thing lost. 	 m. (-कः) The owner of any thing lost.  E. नष्ट, and ठक् aff.
नासत्य: नासत्य m. du. (-त्यौ) The two sons of AŚHWINĪ, and physicians of Swarga. 	 f. (-त्या) The constellation AŚHWINĪ.  E. न not, असत्य impure.
नासा: नासा f. (-सा) 	 1. The nose. 	 2. The upper timber of a door. 	 3. The trunk of an elephant.  E. णस् to sound, to stand, अच् aff.
नासाच्छिन्नी: नासाछिन्नी f. (-न्नी) A sort of bird; also पूर्णिका.  E. नासा the nose, छिन्न cut, fem. affix ङीप्.
नासाछिन्नी: नासाछिन्नी f. (-न्नी) A sort of bird; also पूर्णिका.  E. नासा the nose, छिन्न cut, fem. affix ङीप्.
नासादक्षिणावर्त्त: नासादक्षिणावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Wearing the nose-ring in the right nostril by women who have money and children.  E. नासा the nose, दक्षिण the right, and आवर्त्त a turning.
नासादारु: नासादारु m. (-रुः) The upper timber of a door: see नासा.
नासानाह: नासानाह m. (-हः) Thickening of the membrance of the nose, stoppage of the nostrils.  E. नासा, and नाह binding
नासापरिस्राव: नासापरिस्राव m. (-वः) 	 1. Running at the nose. 	 2. A running cold.  E. नासा and परिस्राव flow.
नासारन्ध्र: नासारन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) The nostril.  E. नासा, and रन्ध्र a hole.
नासालु: नासालु m. (-लुः) A plant, commonly Kāyaphal: see कट्फल.  E. नासा the nose, and लु to cut, affix डु.
नासावंश: नासावंश m. (-शः) The bridge of the nose.  E. नासा and वंश bamboo.
नासावामावर्त: नासावामावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Wearing the nose-ring in the left nostril, a mark of sorrow or distress.  E. नासा the nose. वाम the left side, आवर्त्त a turning.
नासावामावर्त्त: नासावामावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Wearing the nose-ring in the left nostril, a mark of sorrow or distress.  E. नासा the nose. वाम the left side, आवर्त्त a turning.
नासाशोष: नासाशोष m. (-षः) Dryness of the nostrils.  E. नासा and शोष drying.
नासिकन्धम: नासिकन्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Blowing or breathing through the nose, snoring, &c.  E. नासिका the nose, ध्मा to blow &c. affix खश्. मुम् ह्रस्वश्च ।
नासिकन्धय: नासिकन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Drinking through the nose.  E. नासिका, and घेट् to drink, affix. खञ् ।
नासिका: नासिका f. (-का) 	 1. The nose. 	 2. The upper timber, or nose as it were, of a door. 	 3. A name of the nymph AŚHwini.  E. नासा as above, affix कन् fem. form. or नास शब्दे ण्वुल् । The same as नासा ।
नासिकाग्र: नासिकाग्र m. (-ग्रं) The tip of the nose.  E. नासिका, and अग्र end.
नासिकामल: नासिकामल n. (-लं) The mucus of the nose, snot.  E. नासिका, and मल excrement; it may also be नासामल । शिङ्घाणे ।
नासिक्य: नासिक्य m. du. (-क्यौ) 	 1. The two sons of Aśhwini. 	 2. A nasal sound. n. (-क्यं) The nose.  E. नासिका, and यत् affix of identity or descent.
नासिक्यक: नासिक्यक n. (-कं) The nose.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
नासीर: नासीर n. (-रं) Advancing or skirmishing in front of an army, leaving the line, and defying the enemy by shouts and gestures. 	 m. (-रः) The van, or a champion who advances before the line.  E. णास् to sound, affix ईरन्; or नासाय शब्दाय इर्त्ते इर-क ।
नास्ति: नास्ति ind. Non-existence, not so, it is not.  E. न negative, and अस्ति is, third person, singular, present tense of अस् to be.
नास्तिक: नास्तिक m. (-कः) An atheist, but applied by the orthodox Hindūs, to any one who denies the divine authority of the Vedas, or doubts the legends of the Purānas, or a future life or the existence of a ruler, or creator of the universe.  E. नास्ति there is not (a god &c.) and ठन् aff.
नास्तिकता: नास्तिकता f. (-ता) Atheism, denial of the deity, of a future state, of the divinity of the Vedas; Buddhism, heresy, &c.  E. तल् abs-tract affix added to the preceding: also with त्व नास्तिकत्व, or with यत् affix नास्तिक्य ।
नास्तिक्य: नास्तिक्य n. (-क्यं) Infidelity, atheism, heresy.  E. नास्तिक, and यत् aff.
नास्तित्व: नास्तित्व n. (-त्वं) Non-existence.  E. त्व added to नास्ति; also with तल् affix नास्तिता; ।
नास्य: नास्य n. (-स्यं) The rein of an ox passed through the septum of the nostrils.  E. नासा the nose, शरीरावयवत्वात् यत् aff. नासायां भवम् ।
नाह: नाह m. (-हः) 	 1. Binding, confinement. 	 2. A trap, a snare for catching deer, &c. 	 3. Obstruction in any organ or secretion of the body, as costiveness, &c.  E. णह् to bind, affix भावे घञ् ।
नाहल: नाहल m. (-लः) A man of a barbarous or outcast tribe.
नाहुषि: नाहुषि m. (-षिः) The name of a king; also YAYĀTI.  E. नहुष, and इञ् affix of descent. Also नाहुष ।
निःकारण: निःकारण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Causeless, unfounded.  E. निर् neg. कारण cause.
निःकासन: निःकासन n. (-नं) Expulsion, exile, turning out.  E. निर्, and कस् to go, causal form, ल्युट् affix; also निःकाशन ।
निःकासित: निःकासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned out or forth, expelled, removed. E. निर् out, कस् to go, in the causal form, affix क्त; also निष्कासित, निःकाशित and निष्काशित ।
निःक्रामित: निःक्रामित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, turned out.  E. निः for निर् out, क्रामित caused to go, also निष्क्रामित ।
निःक्षत्र: निःक्षत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Having none of the military tribe, (in a city, &c.)  E. निर् not, चत्र a Kshetriya.
निःक्षिप्त: निःक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 	 1. Thrown or sent away. 	 2. Spent. 	 3. Passed. E. निर् before, क्षिप्त to throw, &c. affix क्त ।
निःक्षिप्य: निःक्षिप्य ind. 	 1. Having thrown or sent away. 	 2. Having spent, (as time.) 	 3. Having wiped away, (as tears,) &c.  E. निर् before, क्षिप् to throw, and ल्यप् aff.
निःक्षेप: निःक्षेप m. (-पः) 	 1. Throwing, sending, putting away. 	 2. Spending. 3 Passing, (as time.) 	 4. Wiping away, (as tears)  E. निर् and क्षिप् to throw, घञ् aff.
निःप्रभ: निःप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Gloomy, dark, obscured.  E. निः for निर् priva-tive, and प्रभा light; also निष्प्रभ.
निःफल: निःफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fruitless, barren.  E. निर् neg. फल fruit, more commonly निष्फल.
निःशंसय: निःशंसय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Undoubted.  E. निः for निर्, शंसय doubt.
निःशङ्क: निःशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Fearless.  E. निर् and शङ्का apprehension.
निःशलाक: निःशलाक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Solitary, private.  E. निः for निर् privative, and शलाका the maina; not even frequented by birds; also निश्शलाक.
निःशब्द: निःशब्द mfn. (-ब्दः-ब्दा-ब्दं) Silent, voiceless.  E. निः for निर्, and शब्द sound.
निःशूक: निःशूक m. (-कः) Rice without any awn or beard.  E. निः for निर् and शूक beard of corn.
निःशेष: निःशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Complete, entire.  E. निः for निर् negative, and शेष remainder; also निश्शेष.
निःशोध्य: निःशोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Cleansed, cleared, purified.  E. निः for निर् implying completion, and शोध्य pure; also निश्शोध्य.
निःश्रयणी: निःश्रयणी f. (-णी) Wooden steps, a ladder, a staircase.  E. निः for निर् out, forth, श्रि to go, affix ल्युट्; also with अच् affix, and इनि added, निःश्रयिणी.
निःश्रेणि: निःश्रेणि f. (-णिः-णी) 	 1. A ladder or staircase, a flight of steps. 	 2. The wild date tree.  E. निः for निर् implying certainty, and श्रेणी a line also निश्श्रेणी.
निश्रेयसः: निश्रेयसः n. (-यः) 	 1. Final beatitude, the release of the soul from the body, and its reunion with the primary and universal spirit. 	 2. Happiness, welfare. 	 3. Knowledge, learning. 	 4. Belief, faith, devotedness. 	 5. Apprehension, conception. 	 m. (-याः) A name of SIVA.  E. निः for निर् implying eternity or certainty, श्रेयस् best, अच् added; also निश्श्रेयस.
निःश्वसन: निःश्वसन n. (-नं) 	 1. Sighing, &c. 	 2. Breathing out.  E. निर् and श्वसन breathing.
निःश्वसित: निःश्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sighed, sig hing. 	 2. Breathing out. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Expiration. 	 2. Sighing.  E. निर् and श्वस् to breathe, क्त aff.
निःश्वस्य: निःश्वस्य ind. Having sighed.  E. निर् and श्वस् to breathe, affix ल्यप्.
निःश्वास: निःश्वास m. (-सः) 	 1. Breathing out, expiration. 	 2. Sighing.  E. निर्, and श्वस् to breathe, भावे घञ् aff.
निःश्वासपरम: निःश्वासपरम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Sorrowful.  E. निःश्वास and परम best.
निःषमम्: निःषमम् ind. 	 1. A particle of reproof, (improperly, unseasonably.) 2 A term of regret, (das!)  E. निर् not, सम equal to, र is changed to Visarga, and स becomes ष.
निःसङ्ग: निःसङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 	 1. Separated, unconnected. 	 2. Regardless, indifferent, free from attachment or desire.  E. निर् not, सङ्ग associa-tion.
निःसंज्ञ: निःसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Senseless, insensible.  E. निर् not, संज्ञा sign of life.
निःसत्य: निःसत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) False, untrue.  E. निर् neg. सत्य true.
निःसत्यता: निःसत्यता f. (-ता) Insincerity, falsehood.  E. निर् neg. सत्यता truth.
निःसत्व: निःसत्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) 	 1. Weak, impotent. 	 2. Insignificant, mean, low. 	 3. Non-existent. 	 4. Insubstantial. 	 n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Insignificance, absence of power or consideration. 	 2. Non-existence.  E. निर् neg. सत्व substance, &c.
निःस: निःस(ष)न्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि) Firm, well-knit, compact.  E. निर् not, सन्धि junction; the joints of which are not perceivable. निष्क्रान्तः सन्धेः सुश्लिष्टित्वात् निरादिस० सुषमा-षत्वम् ।
निःसम्पात: निःसम्पात m. (-तः) 	 1. Without motion. 	 2. Midnight.  E. निर् neg. सम्पात going, from पत् to go, with सम् prefix, and घञ् aff.
निःसरण: निःसरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Death, dying. 	 2. A means or expedient. 	 3. Exit, a going forth or out. 	 4. Final beatitude. 	 5. The entrance into a house or town, &c. the gate, the gate-way.  E. निर् forth or out, सृ, to go, भावे ल्युट् aff.
निःसह: निःसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 	 1. Intolerable, unbearable. 	 2. Irresistible. 	 3. Unable to support or bear.  E. निर् neg. सह bearing.
निःसहत्व: निःसहत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Inability to bear or support. 	 2. Impatience, unen-durance.  E. निःसह, and त्व affix; also with तल् निःसहता.
निःसाध्वस: निःसाध्वस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Bold, fearless.  E. निर् and साध्वस fear.
निःसार: निःसार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Sapless, pithless. 	 2. Worthless, vain, insubs-tantial. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A plant, (Trophis aspera.) 	 2. Going forth. 	 f. (-रा) The plantain.  E. निर् privative, सार essence, pith; or निर् out, सृ to go, घञ् aff.
निःसारण: निःसारण n. (-णं) 	 1. Going forth or out. 	 2. The entrance of a house or town, &c. the passage, the road of ingress and egress.  E. निर् forth or out, and सृ to go णिच्ल्युट् aff; see निःसरण.
निःसारित: निःसारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned forth or out, expelled, dismissed. E. निर् out, and सारित caused to go. निर सृ-णिच् कर्मणि क्त ।
निःसुख: निःसुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 	 1. Disagreeable, distressing. 	 2. Unhappy. E. निर् neg. सुख pleasure.
निःसृत: निःसृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone forth or out.  E. निर्, and सृ to go, affix क्त.
निःस्नेह: निःस्नेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 	 1. Dry, not greasy or unctuous. 	 2. Cold, in-sensible, unfeeling. 	 f. (-हा) Linseed, (Linum utilitissimum.) E. निर् forth, out, and स्नेह oil; whence oil is extracted or expressed, &c. or निर् privative, स्नेह oil or affection.
निःस्पृह: निःस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 	 1. Free from desire. 	 2. Disregarding, indiffer-ent to.  E. निर् neg. स्पृहा wish.
निःस्राव: निःस्राव m. (-वः) The moisture or water of boiled rice.  E. निर forth, and स्राव what is oozing or निर-स्रु-ण (फेन) ।
निःस्व: निःस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) Poor, indigent.  E. निर् not, nothing, स्व own property.
निःस्वादु: निःस्वादु mfn. (-दुः-दुः-दु) Insipid, tasteless.  E. निर् neg. स्वादु sweet.
नि: नि ind. 	 1. In, within; on, upon: a particle and prefix. 	 2. A negative or prohibitive particle. 	 3. A particle implying certainty, affirma-tion, proximity, continuance, doubt, intensity, fulness, Lowness, order, skill, wrong, group, &c. see the following compounds.
नि(नी)वार m. (-रः) 	 1. Hindering, opposition, impediment. 	 2. Name of the grain so called.  E. नि prefix, वॄ to screen, घञ्. aff.
नि(श्)श्वसन n. (-नं) 	 1. Breathing out, expiration. 	 2. Sighing.  E. निर् and असन breathing.
नि(श्)श्वास m. (-सः) 	 1. Breath expired, breathing out, expiration.  E. निर् out, and श्वास breath.
निकट: निकट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 	 1. Near, proximate. 	 2. Kinless, solitary.  E. नि, and कटच् affix; or नि prefixed to कट् to go to or towards, affix अच्.
निकर: निकर m. (-रः) 	 1. A flock or multitude. 	 2. A heap, a bundle. 	 3. Pith, sap, essence. 	 4. Suitable or proper gift. 	 5. A treasure, especially belonging to KUVERA: see निधि.  E. नि in or upon, कॄ to throw, affix अप् ।
निकर्षण: निकर्षण m. (-णः) 	 1. An open space or sort of play-ground in or near a town. 	 2. A court at the entrance to a house. 	 3. A neighbourhood. 4. A plot of ground not ploughed.  E. नि, with कर्षण ploughing; so prepared.
निकष: निकष(स) m. (-षः-सः) The touch-stone. 	 f. (-षा) The mother of the imps or goblins.  E. नि prefixed to कष् to injure, affix घ.
निकषा: निकषा ind. 	 1. Near, proximate. 	 2. In the middle, betwixt, between. 	 3. The mother of a Rākshasha.  E. नि prefixed to कष् to hurt, UNĀDI affix आ.
निकषात्मज: निकषात्मज m. (-जः) A Rākshasa, a sort of goblin.  E. निकषा the mother of the race, and आत्मज a son.
निकस: निकस m. (-सः) A touch-stone: see निकष.
निकाम: निकाम n. adv. (-मं) Voluntarily, willingly, implying certainty.  E. नि, काम will.
निकाय: निकाय m. (-यः) An assemblage of persons performing like duties, a congregation, an audience. 	 2. A flock, a multitude. 	 3. A butt, a mark. 	 4. A house, habitation. 	 5. The Supreme Being. 	 6. The body. E. नि in or within, चि to collect, affix घञ्, and क substituted for the radical initial.
निकाय्य: निकाय्य m. (-य्यः) A house.  E. नि in or within, चि to collect, affix ण्यत् कुत्वम् ।
निकार: निकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Opposition, contradiction. 	 2. Injury, wrong, offence. 3. wickedness; malice. 	 4. Abuse, reproach, disrespect. 	 5. Raising, tossing or lifting up. 	 6. Piling or winnowing corn. 	 7. Killing. E. नि depreciative prefix, कृ to make, or कॄ to throw, affix भावे घञ् or अप्.
निकारण: निकारण n. (-णं) Killing, slaughter.  E. नि prefixed to कॄ to injure, affix ल्युट्.
निकाष: निकाष m. (-षः) Rubbing, Scratching.  E. नि before, कष् to hurt, घञ् aff
निकास: निकास(श) mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 	 1. Likeness. (in composition:) 	 2. Proximity 3. Appearance. See नीकास.

निकुञ्ज: निकुञ्ज mn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जं) An arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with creep-ers and shrubs,  E. नि expletive, and कुञ्ज an arbour.
निकुम्भ: निकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. The son of KUMBHAKARṆA, the brother of RĀVAṆA. 2. A plant, (Croton polyandrum)  E. कु the earth, भू to be, affix खच्, and नि prefixed.
निकुम्भिला: निकुम्भिला f. (-ला) A cave situated on the western part of ceylon, where offerings with fire are made.  E. नि before, कुम्भ a jar, इलच् aff.

निकृति: निकृति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Wickedness, dishonesty. 	 2. Abuse, reproach. 	 3. Re-jection, removal. 	 4. Poverty, indigence.  E. नि prefixed to कृत् to cut, affix कि. or नि + कृ-भावे क्तिन् ।

निकेचाय: निकेचाय m. (-यः) Piling or collecting repeatedly.  E. नि before, चि to gather, reit. v., घञ् aff.
निकेत: निकेत m. (-तः) A house, a habitation.  E. नि in, कित् to dwell, affix घञ्; also with युच affix निकेतन.
निकेतक: निकेतक n. (-कः) A house, a dwelling.  E. कन added to निकेत.
निकेतन: निकेतन n. (-नं) A house, a habitation. 	 m. (-नः) An onion E. see निकेत.
निकोच: निकोच(ठ)क m. (-कः) A tree, (Allangium hexapetalum.)  E. नि prefixed to कुच् to be crooked, affix वुन्; also derived from कुठ् to surround, निकोठक; also with अण् pleonasm added, निकौचक or नि + कुच + शब्दे वुन् । अङ्कोट वृक्षे ।
निक्वण: निक्वण m. (-णः) 	 1. A musical tone or sound. 	 2. Any sound.  E. नि prefixed to क्कण् to sound, अप् affix; also with घञ् affix निक्वाण m. (-णः)
निक्ष: निक्ष r. 1st cl. (निक्षति) To kiss: see णिक्ष ।
निक्षण: निक्षण n. (-णं) Kissing.  E. निक्ष् to kiss, ल्युट् aff.
निक्षा: निक्षा f. (-क्षा) A nit.  E. णिश् to meditate, Unādi affix अच् according to some a wrong form of लिक्षा ।

निक्षिपत्: निक्षिपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) Throwing or placing in or upon.  E. नि before, क्षिप् to throw, affix शतृ ।
निक्षेप: निक्षेप m. (-पः) 	 1. A pledge, a deposit in general, or one which is count-ed or particularised in presence of the receiver, and left without cover or seal. 	 2.
