निक्षेप्तृ: निक्षेप्तृ mfn. (-प्ता-प्त्री-प्तृ) Who or what places or deposits. 	 m. (-प्ता) A de-positor, a pawner or pledger.  E. नि before, क्षिप् to throw, तृच् aff.
निखर्व: निखर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Dwarfish, a dwarf. 	 n. (-र्व्वं) A billion.  E. नि certainly, verily खर्व्व short &c.
निखर्व्व: निखर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Dwarfish, a dwarf. 	 n. (-र्व्वं) A billion.  E. नि certainly, verily खर्व्व short &c.
निखात: निखात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Dug dug, up, excavated. 	 2. Fixed in the ground as a snake.  E. नि before खन् to dig, क्त aff.
निखिल: निखिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) All, entire, complete.  E. नि negative, खिल de-fective. निवृत्तं खिलं शेषो यस्मात् ।
निगड: निगड mn. (-डः-डं) Iron chain for the feet, a fetter, but especially the heel chains of an elephant.  E. नि not, गड् to drop, (to drop off,) affix अच् । नि + गल + अच् । डलयोरैक्यात् डत्वम् ।
निगडित: निगडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, tied, chained &c.  E. निगड a chain, तार-इतच् aff.
निगण: निगण m. (-णः) The smoke of a burnt offering or sacrificial fire.  E. नि implying certainty, prefixed to गण् to estimate, affix क; by which presence of fire is indicated.
निगद: निगद m. (-दः) 	 1. Speech, speaking, discourse. 	 2. Audible recitation of prayers or charms.  E. नि affirmative prefix, गद speech. अच् aff.
निगदत्: निगदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Speaking, saying, speaking to, addressing. E. निगद to speak, शतृ aff.
निगदित: निगदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, spoken,  E. नि before गद् to speak, क्त aff.
निगदितवत्: निगदितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Speaking, having spoken.  E. नि before, गद् to speak, क्तवतु aff.
निगम: निगम m. (-मः) 	 1. A town, a city. 	 2. A market, a fair. 	 2. Holywrit, the Vedas collectively. 	 4. A road, a market road. 	 5. Trade, traffic. 	 6. A camp or caravan of itinerant dealers, as Bazaris, &c. 	 7. Certainty, assurance. 	 8. Logic.  E. नि affirmative prefix, गम to go, affix घञ् by which people go, &c. निगम्यते अत्र अनेन वा नि + गम-घञ् ।
निगमन: निगमन n. (-नं) 	 1. Certain or logical conclusion, the winding up of a syllogism. 	 2. Quotations of words from the Vedas. 	 3. The con-clusion in a syllogism, the deduction (the fifth member of a five-membered syllogism. (In logic.) 	 4. Going.  E. नि, and गमन going.
निग: निग(गा)र m. (-रः) Eating, swallowing  E. नि in, गॄ to swallow, affix अप्.
निग(गा)रण n. (-णं) Eating, swallowing. 	 m. (-णः) 	 1. The throat, the gullet. 2. Smoke of a burnt offering.  E. नि prefixed to गॄ to swallow, affix ल्युट् ।
निगाद: निगाद m. (-दः) 	 1. Speech, discourse. 	 2. A prayer recited aloud  E. नि before गद् to speak, affix घञ्; also निगद ।
निगार: निगार m. (-रः) Swallowing.  E. नि prefixed to गॄ to swallow, affix घञ्; also निगर ।
निगा: निगा(ग)ल m. (-लः) Throat or neck of a horse.  E. नि before, गल् to eat, affix घञ् or नि + गॄ + धञ् अप् वा-रस्य लः ।
निगालवत्: निगालवत् m. (-वान्) A horse.  E. निगाल as above, and अस्त्यर्थे मतुप् aff. मस्य-वः ।
निगीत: निगीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sung, said.  E. नि and गीत sung.
निगु: निगु m. (-गुः) 	 1. A root. 	 2. The mind, the faculty of feeling and reasoning. 	 3. Painting. 	 4. excrement  E. नि affirmation, ग्रह to take, affix डु । रलोपश्च ।
निगूढ: निगूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Profound, obscure. 	 2. Hidden, concealed. 3. Embraced, m. (-ढः) A sort of wild bean; see मुद्ग  E. नि before, गुह् to hide or conceal, affix क्त. आलिङ्गिते, वनमुद्गे च ।
निगूढार्थ: निगूढार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Having a hidden sense or purpose.  E. निगूढ, and अर्थ meaning.
निगूहनीय: निगूहनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be hid or concealed. 	 2. To be protected or defended.  E. नि before, गुह् to conceal, अनीयर् aff.
निगृहीत: निगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Assailed, attacked. 	 2. Harassed, spoiled. 	 3. Seized, arrested. 	 4. Restrained, subdued, checked.  E. नि before, ग्रह् to take, क्त aff.
निगृहीति: निगृहीति f. (-तिः) Restraint, check, &c.: see निग्रह,  E. नि before, ग्रह to take, क्तिन् aff.
निगृह्णत्: निगृह्णत् mfn. (-ह्णन्-ह्णन्ती-ह्णत्) 	 1. Seizing, taking 2. Suppressing, restrain-ing.  E. नि before, ग्रह् to take, शतृ aff.
निगृह्य: निगृह्य ind. 	 1. Having taken. 	 2. Having restrained or suppressed. 	 3. Having arrested or confined.  E. नि before, ग्रह् to take, ल्यप् aff.
निग्रह: निग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. Aversion, disfavour, discouragement, dislike. 	 2. Abusing. 	 3. Binding, confinement, capture, arrest, 4. A binding, a tie. 	 5. Restraint, subjection. 	 6. Suppression, putting down. 	 7. A boundary, a limit. 	 8. Administering medicine. 	 9. Killing. 	 10. A name of KRISHṆA. 	 11. Removing. 	 12. A flaw in an argument. 13. A handle.  E. नि before, ग्रह् to take or seize, affix अप्.
निग्रहण: निग्रहण n. (-णं) 	 1. Subduing, suppression. 	 2. Defeat. 	 3. Capture. 	 4. Punishment in general.  E. नि before ग्रह् to take, ल्युट् aff.
निग्रहस्थान: निग्रहस्थान n. (-नं) Failure in logical argument.  E. निग्रह, and स्थान place.
निग्राह: निग्राह m. (-हः) Aversion, &c. used as an imprecation, as, निग्राहस्ते भूयात् confusion seize you, &c.  E. नि before, ग्रह् to seize, affix घञ् ।
निघ: निघ m. (-घः) 	 1. A round or circle, a ball, any thing whose height and circumference are equal. 	 2. A tree. 	 3. Sin.  E. नि before, हन् to kill, affix क, deriv irr.
निघण्टु: निघण्टु m. (-ण्टुः) A vocabulary, a collection of words or names.
निघस: निघस m. (-सः) 	 1. Food, victuals. 	 2. Eating, Dining.  E. नि before, अद् to eat, अप् affix, and घस् substituted for the root.
निघाति: निघाति m. (-तिः) An iron club or mace.  E. नि before, हन् to kill, इञ् Unādi affix, and घात substituted for the root.
निघानिघ: निघानिघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Of different forms or sizes.
निघुष्ट: निघुष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Sound, noise.  E. नि before, घुष् to sound, affix क्त.
निघृष्व: निघृष्व m. (-ष्वः) 	 1. A hoof. 	 2. A mule. 	 3. A boar. 	 4. A road.  E. नि before, घृष् to pound, Unādi affix वन् or क्कन् । Der: Irreg.
निघ्न: निघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं) 	 1. Docile, subservient, domestic, dependant. 	 2. Completing a quotient, (in Arithmetic.) 	 3. Dependant on a sub-stantive (as an adjective.)  E. नि before, हन् to injure or do mis-chief, घञर्थे क aff.
निघ्नत्: निघ्नत् mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नन्ती-घ्नत्) 	 1. Slaying. Destroying, overcoming.  E. नि before, हन् to kill, शतृ aff.
निघ्नान: निघ्नान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Slaying, killing.  E. नि before, हन् to kill, शानच् aff.
निचय: निचय m. (-यः) 	 1. Heap, assemblage, collection. 	 2. Certainty. 	 3. An assemblage of parts constituting a whole.  E. नि before, चि to collect, affix भावे अच् ।
निचयिन्: निचयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Having or containing a quantity, full of, redolent with, abounding.  E. निचय, and इनि aff.
निचिकी: निचिकी f. (-की) A capital cow: see नैचिकी.
निचित: निचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. full, filled. 	 2. Covered, overspread. 	 3. Raised up. 	 4. Narrowed.  E. नि before, चि to collect, affix क्त.
निचुल: निचुल m. (-लः) 	 1. A plant, (Barringtonia acutangula.) 	 2. An upper and outer garment. 	 3. A name of a poet.  E. नि before, चुल् to lift up, affix क । हिज्जले तथा वेतसवृक्षे च ।
निचुलक: निचुलक n. (-कं) A breast-plate, a cuirass.  E. क्कुन् added to the preceding; also निचोलक ।
निचोल: निचोल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) A cover, a wrapper, a veil, a surtout. 	 2. A bed cover. 	 3. The cover of a litter.  E. नि before, चुल् to lift up, affix अच् ।
निचोलक: निचोलक m. (-कः) A sort of jacket, but especially a soldier's jacket, or a body dress, serving as a cuirass or breast-plate.  E. कन् added to निचोल ।
निच्छवि: निच्छवि m. (-विः) A district, the modern Tirhut.  E. नि constantly, छवि light; or निकृष्टा छविरत्र ।
निच्छिद्र: निच्छिद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Unimpeached.  E. नि neg. छिद्र flaw.
निच्छिवि: निच्छिवि m. (-विः) A man of one of the degraded classes, born from the outcast Kshetriya; the occupation of this caste is apparently public exhibition of tricks, prize-fighting, &c. being classed with the Jhallas, Mallas, and others.  E. नि privative, छवि light or credit, इ substituted for the penultimate.
निच्छेद: निच्छेद m. (-दः) 	 1. Cutting off. 	 2. Leaving no common measure. (In Arithmetic.)  E. नि, and छेद cutting.
निज: निज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 	 1. Own. 	 2. Perpetual, eternal. 	 3. Peculiar. E. नि implying continuance, and ज what is produced. नितरां जायते नि + जन-ड ।
निजिघृक्षयत्: निजिघृक्षयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Desirous of making to excel.  E. नि be-fore, ग्रह् to take, desid v., शतृ aff.
निजुह्नुषु: निजुह्नुषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to conceal.  E. नि before, ह्नु to hide, desid. v., उ aff.
निटल: निटल n. (-लं) The forehead.  E. नि before, टल् to be marked, (with frowns, &c.) affix अच्; also with घञ् added निटाल ।
निटलाक्ष: निटलाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A name of SIVA  E. निटल the forehead, and अक्ष an eye.
निडीन: निडीन n. (-नं) The downward flight of a bird or a peculiar mode of flying.  E. नि affirmative prefix and डीन flight, flying.
निण्डिका: निण्डिका f. (-का) A plant commonly Teori.
नितम्ब: नितम्ब m. (-म्बः) 	 1. A woman's buttock's. 	 2. The buttocks or posteriors in general, or as it is sometimes applied, to the circumference of the hip and loins. 	 3. The shoulder. 	 4. The side of a mountain. 	 5. The sloping bank or shore of a river.  E. नि prefixed to तम्ब् to go, affix अच्; or तम् to go with ब aff. निभृतं तम्यते काम्यते कामुकैः ।
नितम्बिनी: नितम्बिनी f. (-नी) A woman with large and handsome posteriors. E. नितम्ब as above, इनि and ङीप् affs.
नितराम्: नितराम् ind. 	 1. Always, continually, eternally. 	 2. Especially, particu-larly. 	 3. Hence.  E. नि always, तरप् comparative affix, and आमु added.
नितल: नितल m. (-लः) One of the seven divisions of Pātāla or hell.  E. नि not, (known,) तल depth. नितान्ते, एकान्ते च ।
नितान्त: नितान्त adj. 	 mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Much, excessive. adv. 	 n. (-न्तं) much, ex-cessively.  E. नि prefixed to तम् to desire, affix क्त, and the vowel made long.
नित्य: नित्य mfn. adj. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 	 1. Eternal, everlasting, continual, perpe-tual, past, present, and future. 	 2. Regular, fixed, invariable. 3. Ordinary. 	 4. Necessary. 	 n. adv. (-त्यं) Always, eternally, conti-nually. sub. Indispensable rite or act. 	 m. (-त्यः) The ocean. 	 f. (-त्या) 1. A name of PĀRVATĪ. 	 2. The goddess MANASĀ. 	 3. A Saktī, a form of DURGĀ, or personified energy of SIVA.  E. नि particle implying perpetually, and त्यप aff.

नित्यकर्म्मन्: नित्यकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Indispensable act or ceremony, as observance of the five great sacrifices, or any daily and necessary rite.  E. नित्य, and कर्म्म act; also नित्यक्रिया, &c.
नित्यकृत्य: नित्यकृत्य n. (-त्यं) Regular and necessary act or ceremony.  E. नित्य, and कृत्य to be done.
नित्यगति: नित्यगति m. (-तिः) Air or wind.  E. नित्य eternal, गति motion.
नित्यता: नित्यता f. (-ता) Perpetuity, eternity.  E. तल् added to नित्य; also with त्व, नित्यत्वं ।
नित्यदान: नित्यदान ind. Always, constantly, and eternally.  E. नित्य, and दाच् aff.
नित्यदान n. (-नं) Daily alms.  E. नित्य, and दान gift.
नित्यनैमित्तिक: नित्यनैमित्तिक n. (-कं) Any act or ceremony which though occasional is of irregular recurrence, as Srāddhas at fixed lunar periods.  E. नित्य, and नैमित्तिक occasional; also नित्यनैमित्तिककर्म्मन् ।
नित्यप्रलय: नित्यप्रलय m. (-यः) 	 1. Sleep. 	 2. The constant loss of living beings. E. नित्य and प्रलय destruction.
नित्ययुक्त: नित्ययुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Always busy or engaged in.  E. नित्य and युक्त attached to.
नित्ययौवन: नित्ययौवन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ever or always young. 	 f. (-ना) A name of DRAUPADI.  E. नित्य always, and यौवन youth.
नित्यशस्: नित्यशस् ind. Always. constantly, eternally.  E. नित्य, and शसि aff.
नित्यसम: नित्यसम m. (-मः) An erroneous answer, one asserting perpetuity for perishable things.  E. नित्य, and सम same.
नित्यानध्याय: नित्यानध्याय m. (-यः) A period when the perusal of the Vedas is invari-ably prohibited, as the day of full moon, new moon, the eighth and fourteenth days of the half month.  E. नित्य always, अन् nega-tive prefix, अध्याय to be read.
नित्यानित्य: नित्यानित्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Eternal and perishable, permanent and tem-porary, &c.  E. नित्य, and अनित्य transient.
निद: निद (इ) निदि r. 1st cl. (निन्दति) To reproach, to blame.
निद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Abusive. 	 n. (-दं) Poison, venom.  E. नि affirmative prefix, दो to destroy, affix ड or निदि-क, वा नलोपः ।
निदत्त: निदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given, given absolutely.  E. नि and दत्त given.
निदद्रु: निदद्रु mf. (-द्रुः-द्रुः) A man.  E. निद poison, and द्रु tree, a living Upas.
निदर्शन: निदर्शन n. (-नं) 	 1. An example or illustration. 	 2. Injunction, precept. 	 3. Tenour, purport. 	 4. Authority, text. 	 5. A sign. 	 6. A scheme. 	 7. View. 	 8. Evidence.  E. नि fully or certainly, दर्शन showing, or नि + दृश ल्युट् ।
निदाघ: निदाघ m. (-घः) 	 1. The hot season, (May and June.) 	 2. Heat, warmth. 2. Sweat, perspiration.  E. नि always, दह् to burn, आधारे घञ् affix, न्यङ्क्वादि० कुत्वम् ।
निदाघकर: निदाघकर m. (-रः) The sun.  E. निदाघ the hot season, and कर who makes.
निदाघकाल: निदाघकाल m. (-लः) The hot season, two months previous to rains, about May and June  E. निदाघ, and काल time or season.
निदाघसिन्धु: निदाघसिन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A river in the hot weather, one nearly dry. E. निदाघ, and सिन्धु a river.
निदान: निदान n. (-नं) 	 1. A first cause, a primary or remote cause. 	 2. Diappear-ance, cessation or removal of a first cause. 	 3. Purification purity, correctness. 	 4. Asking for the recompense or objects of austere devo-tion. 	 5. End, cessation. 	 6. A rope for tying a calf. 	 7. Ascertaining the causes of disease, study of symptoms with a view to trace the remote or proximate causes; hence this word is the name of a divi-sion of all works on medicine.  E. नि always or certainly, देङ् to cherish affix पालने ल्युट्; by which all effects are produced.
निदिग्ध: निदिग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Smeared, anointed, plastered. 	 f. (-ग्धा) 	 1. Small cardamoms. 	 2. Increasing.  E. नि prefixed to दिह् to smear, affix क्त.
निदिग्धिका: निदिग्धिका f. (-का) A sort of prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.) E. कन् added to the preceding. कण्टकारिकायाम् ।
निदिध्यासन: निदिध्यासन n. (-नं) Deep and repeated consideration, thinking of or recalling repeatedly.  E. नि before, ध्यै in the reiterative form, affix ल्यु.
निदिष्ट: निदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Ordered, directed. 	 2. Advised, enjoined. 	 3. Explained, pointed out.  E. नि implying certainty, दिश् to show, affix क्त ।
निदेश: निदेश m. (-शः) 	 1. Order, command, direction, instruction. 	 2. Speech, speaking, saying, relating. 	 3. Vicinity, proximity. 	 4. The word of command.  E. नि verily, दिश् to show, affix घञ् ।
निदेशिन्: निदेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Showing, directing, pointing out. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A quarter of space. 	 2. A point of the compass.  E. नि before, दिश् to show, णिनि aff.
निदेष्टृ: निदेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who or what show or points out, explaining, advising, commanding, &c.  E. नि before दिश् to show, तृच् aff.
निद्रा: निद्रा f. (-द्रा) 	 1. Sleep, sleepiness, sloth. 	 2. Dream.  E. णिद् to condemn or censure, Unādi affix रक्; or द्रै to sleep, affix क्विप् and नि pre-fixed. or more correctly. नि + द्रा भावे अ ।
निद्राण: निद्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Asleep, sleepy, drowsy. 	 2. Shut up, closed. E. निद्रा as above, affix क्त । नि + द्रा-तस्य नः ।
निद्रात्: निद्रात् mfn. (-द्राण द्रान्ती-द्रात्) Sleeping.  E. नि before, द्रा to go, affix शतृ ।
निद्राभङ्ग: निद्राभङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Awaked, aroused from sleep.  E. निद्रा, भङ्ग breaking.
निद्रायमाण: निद्रायमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Sleeping, asleep.  E. नि before द्रै to sleep, शानच् aff.
निद्रालु: निद्रालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Sleeping, sleepy, drowsy, slothful. 	 m. (-लुः) A name of Vishṇu. 	 f. (-लुः) A sort of perfume, commonly नीली. E. निद्रा, and शीलार्थे आलु aff.
निद्रावृक्ष: निद्रावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) Darkness.  E. निद्रा sleep, and वृक्ष a tree, (whose fruit is sleep.)
निद्रासंजनन: निद्रासंजनन n. (-नं) Phlegm, phlegmatic humour.  E. निद्रा sleep, and संजनन producing, occasioning. निद्रां संजनयति सम्-जन-णिच् ल्यु ।
निधन: निधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Poor. 	 mn. (-नः-नं) 	 1. Race, family. 	 2. Loss, dis-appearance, annihilation, 3. Death, dying. 	 4. The seventh asterism of the lunar mansions, reckoning from that under which a person is born. 	 m. (-नः) The head of a family.  E. नि before धा to cherish, affix अच्, or नि neg. धन wealth, or नि + धा + क्यु ।
निधनकारिन्: निधनकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Destroying, destructive.  E. निधन and कारिन् making.
निधनता: निधनता f. (-ता) Poverty.  E. निधन, and तल् added; also with त्व, निधनत्वं.
निधान: निधान n. (-नं) 	 1. A Nidhi or divine treasure, belonging especially to KUVERA the god of wealth. 	 2. A receptacle, a place or vessel in or on which any thing is collected or deposited. 	 3. Place of cessa-tion or rest. 	 4. Property, possessions, wealth.  E. नि in or on, धा to possess, Unādi affix क्यप् or according to others भावे ल्युट्ः see निधि ।
निधापक: निधापक m. (-कः) 	 1. A weapon. 	 2. Burnt timber, charcoal. 	 3. The castor oil plant.
निधाय: निधाय ind. Having fixed or placed in or on.  E. नि before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
निधि: निधि m. (-धिः) 	 1. One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or divine treasures, nine of which are enumerated: viz. The Padma, Mahāpadma, Sankha, Makara, Kachchapa, Mukunda, Kunda, Nila, and Kharba: their nature is not exactly defined, though some of them appears to be precious gems; according to the Tāntrika system, they are per-sonified and worshipped as demi-gods, attendant either upon KUVERA or upon LAKSHMĪ, the goddess of prosperity. 	 2. A recep-tacle, a place of asylum or accumulation, as a treasury, a granary, a nest, &c.; also figuratively, as गुणनिधिः a man who contains or is endowed with all good qualities. 	 3. A treasure, any sum or quan-tity of wealth or valuables. 	 4. A medicinal plant and perfume, commonly Jivaka. 	 5. The ocean. 	 6. An epithet of Vishṇu  E. नि in, धा to have, affix. आधारे कि ।
निधिनाथ: निधिनाथ m. (-थः) A name of KUVERA.  E. निधि a divine treasure and नाथ lord; also similar compounds, as निधिप्रभु निधीश्वर, &c.
निधीयमान: निधीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being in the course of placing, depositing, &c.  E. नि before, धा to have, causal form, शानच् aff.
निधीश: निधीश m. (-शः) KUVERA.  E. निधि as above, and ईश lord.
निधुवन: निधुवन n. (-नं) 	 1. Coition, copulation. 	 2. Trembling, agitation. 	 3. Plea-sure, enjoyment. 	 4. Sport, play, pastime.  E. नि before धू to shake or agitate, युच् aff. नितरां धुवनं हस्तपादादिचालनमत्र ।
निधुवन m. (-नः) Sound.  E. नि before, ध्वन् to sound, affix भावे घञ्.
निधेय: निधेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be placed in or on, to be deposited, &c.  E. नि before धा to have, यत् aff. स्त्रियां टाप् ।
निध्यान: निध्यान n. (-नं) sight, seeing.  E. नि before, ध्यै to think, affix भावे ल्युट्.
निनङ्क्षु: निनङ्क्षु mfn. (-ङ्क्षुः-ङ्क्षुः-ङ्क्षु) Wishing to kill.  E. नि before, णश् to destroy, desid. v, उ affix, form irr. or correctly नश-सन्-उ नुम् ।
निनद: निनद m. (-दः) Sound in general.  E. नि before नद् to sound, affix भावे अप्; also निनाद.
निनयन: निनयन n. (-नं) Engaging in performance.  E. नि before, णी to lead, ल्युट् aff.
निनाद: निनाद m. (-दः) Sound in general.  E. नि before नद् to sound, affix पक्षे घञ्; also निनद.
निनादित: निनादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded.  E. नि before नद् to sound, causal v., क्त aff.
निनीषा: निनीषा f. (-षा) Desire to take or lead.  E. णी to lead, desid. form, affixes अङ्. and टाप्.
निनीषु: निनीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous to take or lead.  E. णी to lead, desid. form, उ aff.
निन्दक: निन्दक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Reproachful, abusive, scurrilous, censorious. E. निदि to abuse, ण्वुल् aff. or निन्द-वुञ् ।
निन्दत्: निन्दत् mfn. (-न्दन्-न्दन्ती-न्दत्) Abusing, blaming.  E. निन्द to blame, शतृ aff.
निन्दतल: निन्दतल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Having a maimed or defective hand: it is also sometimes read निम्नतक.  E. निन्द as above, तल the fore-arm and कर्मणि घञ् aff.
निन्दन: निन्दन n. (-नं) Reproach, censure, blame.  E. णिद्, to reprove, affix ल्युट्.
निन्दा: निन्दा f. (-न्दा) 	 1. Censure, reproach, reproof, blame, abuse, reviling, defamation. 	 2. Injury, injuring. 	 3. Wickedness.  E. णिद् to abuse, &c. affixes अङ् and टाप् or निन्दि भावे अ ।
निन्दास्तुति: निन्दास्तुति f. (-तिः) Irony, ironical praise.  E. निन्दा censure, and स्तुति praise.
निन्दित: निन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Abused, reviled, reproved, 2. Low, despi-cable, worthy of being reviled. 	 3. Prohibited, forbidden.  E. णिद् to abuse, affix क्त.
निन्दु: निन्दु f. (-न्दुः) A woman bearing a dead child.  E. णिदि to abuse, affix कर्मणि उ ।
निन्द्य: निन्द्य mfn. (-न्द्यः-न्द्या-न्द्यं) 	 1. Bad, vile despicable, reprehensible. 	 2. Forbidden, Prohibited.  E. निन्दा, and, यत् aff.
निप: निप mn. (-पः-पं) A water jar. 	 m. (-पः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea cadamba.)  E. नि continuative Particle, पा to drink, affix करणे घञर्थे क ।
निप(पा)ठ m. (-ठः) Reading, studying or lecturing.  E. नि before. पठ् to read, affix भावे अप् पक्षे घञ् वा; also with ल्युट् निपठनं ।
निपठित: निपठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Read, studied,  E. नि पठ् to read, क्त. aff.
निपठिति: निपठिति f. (-तिः) Reading, study.  E. नि पठ् to read, क्तिन् aff.
निपतत्: निपतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) 	 1. Falling, falling down, prostrating. 	 2. Alighting.  E. नि before पत् to fall, affix शतृ.
निपतन: निपतन n. (-नं) 	 1. Falling. 	 2. Alighting, descending.  E. नि in or on, पत to go, ल्युट् aff.
निपतित: निपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Fallen, fallen down. 	 2. Alighted, descended. E. नि in or on, पत् to go, क्त aff.
निपत्य: निपत्य ind. 	 1. Having fallen down, prostrate. 	 2. Having alighted.  E. नि before पत् to fall, ल्यप् aff.
निपत्या: निपत्या f. (-त्या) 	 1. A field of battle. 	 2. Any plashy or slippery ground. E. नि in or on, पत् to fall, आधारे क्यप् aff.
निपाक: निपाक m. (-कः) Cooking, maturing, ripening.  E. नि before पच् to cook, affix घञ् ।
निपाठ: निपाठ m. (-ठः) Reading, study of the sacred books, or public perusal of popular poems.  E. नि before, पठ् to read, affix घञ् ।
निपात: निपात m. (-तः) 	 1. Death, dying. 	 2. Falling, coming down, alighting. 	 3. Irregularity, (in Grammar,) 	 4. A particle, (in ditto.) 	 5. Attack-ing. 	 6. Casting. 	 7. Accidental occurrence or mention.  E. नि before, पत् to go, affix भावे घञ् ।
निपातन: निपातन n. (-नं) 	 1. Causing to descend or fall, throwing down. 	 2. Bea-ting, knocking down. 	 3. Killing. 	 4. (In Grammar,) Irregularity, exception.  E. नि before, पत् to fall, it the causal form, णिच्-ल्युट् aff.
निपातित: निपातित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Beaten down, made to fall or descend. 	 2. Killed. 	 3. Irregular, excepted.  E. नि before पत् to fall, causal form, affix क्त ।
निपान: निपान n. (-नं) 	 1. A trough or ditch near a well for watering cattle. 	 2. A well. 	 3. Any reservoir of water, a pool, a puddle. 	 4. A milk-pail. 	 5. Drinking off, imbibing.  E. नि before. पा to drink, आधारे ल्युट् affix: also with कन् added निपानक n. (-कं ।)
निपीडन: निपीडन n. (-नं) 	 1. Squeezing, pressing. 	 2. Embracing. 	 3. Hurting, giving pain.  E. नि before, पीड् to give pain, भावे ल्युट् aff.
निपीडित: निपीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Squeezed, pressed. 	 2. Embraced. 	 3. Pained, hurt.  E. नि before, पीड् to give pain, affix क्त ।
निपीड्य: निपीड्य ind. 	 1. Having pressed or squeezed, having pressed against or upon. 	 2. Having embraced, 3. Having hurt.  E. नि before, पीड् to pain and ल्यप् aff.
निपीत: निपीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Drank, drank up. 	 2. Absorbed, imbibed, dried up.  E. नि before, पा to drink, क्त aff.
निपीतमान: निपीतमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being drank.  E. नि before, पा to drink, pass. form, शानच् aff.
निपुण: निपुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Clever, skilful, conversant with. 	 2. Skilled in. 3. Kindly or friendly towards. 	 4. Sharp, fine, delicate. 	 5. Com-plete, perfect.  E. नि before, पुण् to be pure, affix क ।
निबद्ध: निबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Bound, confined. 	 2. Bound, costive. 	 3. Fixed upon, fastened to. 	 4. Checked, restrained, 5. Restricted to.  E. नि before बध् to bind, and, affix क्त ।
निबन्ध: निबन्ध m. (-न्धः) 	 1. Epistasis suppression of urine or constipation. 	 2. Commentary, explanation of technical rules. 	 3. The Nimb tree: see निम्ब. 	 4. Binding, confinement. 	 5. (-न्धं) Song, singing.  E. नि before, बन्धि to bind, affix घञ् ।
निबन्धदान: निबन्धदान n. (-नं) Grant of an assignment, gift of a corrody.  E. निबन्ध, and दान gift.
निबन्धन: निबन्धन n. (-नं) 	 1. Cause, motive, origin. 	 2. Binding, confining. 	 3. Checking, restraining. 	 4. Fastening. 	 5. A grant, an assignment. 6. A commentary. 	 7. The tie or peg of a lute. 	 8. Constructing, building. 	 9. A receptacle. 	 10. A bond, a fetter. 	 11. Support. 	 12. Syntax. (in gram.) 	 13. Composing. 	 14. Composition, a treatise. E. नि before, बधि to bind, affix ल्युट्.
निबन्धित: निबन्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, confined, tied.  E. नि before, बन्ध् to bind affix क्त.
निबन्धृ: निबन्धृ mfn. (-न्धा-न्ध्री-न्धृ) Who or what ties or binds. 	 m. (-न्धा) An author, a commentator.  E. नि affirmative, बन्ध् bind, तृच् aff.
निभ: निभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Like, resembling, similar. 	 mn. (-भः-भं) 	 1. fraud, trick, disguise, pretence. 	 2. Light, manifestation, appearance.  E. नि before, भा to shine, affix क.
निभालन: निभालन n. (-नं) Sight, seeing.  E. नि before भाल् to see, affix ल्युट्.
निभूत: निभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Past, gone. 	 f. (-ता) Quite frightened.  E. नि affirm-ative, भूत been.
निभृत: निभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Modest, humble, unassuming. 	 2. Lonely, soli-tary. 	 3. Placed down. 	 4. Secret. 	 5. Still, Silent. 	 6. Firm. 	 7. On the point of setting. 	 8. Filled with.  E. नि before, भृ to cherish, affix क्त.

निरर्थक: निरर्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Vain, fruitless, unprofitable. 	 2. Unmeaning. E. निर् not, अर्थ object, end, कन् added.
निरव: निरव m. (-वः) Loss of voice.  E. नि neg. and रव sound.
निरवग्रह: निरवग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Self-willed, headstrong, independent, uncon-trolled.  E. निर् neg. अवग्रह control.
निरवद्य: निरवद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Unobjectionable, unexceptionable.  E. निर् neg. अवद्य not to be said.
निरवशेषतस्: निरवशेषतस् ind. Fully, particularly, circumstantially.  E. निर् neg. अवशेषतस् a remainder.
निरवसाद: निरवसाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Animated, anxious, eager.  E. निर् neg. अवसाद languor.
निरवहानिका: निरवहानिका f. (-का) A fence, a hedge, an outer wall.  E. निर् out, with-out, and अवहानिका a fence. निर + अव + हन-ण्वुल ।
निरशन: निरशन n. (-नं) Fasting, going without food.  E. निर् and अशन, eating.
निरस: निरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 	 1. Dry. 	 2. Insipid, tasteless. 	 m. (-सः) 	 1. Insi-pidity, want of flavour or passion. 	 2. Dryness, want of juice.  E. नि neg. रस juice, &c. also नीरस.
निरसन: निरसन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) What removes, expels, subdues, checks, &c. n. (-नं) 	 n. 1. Rejection, denial, contradiction, disallowance. 	 2. Suppressing, checking. 	 3. Appeasing. 	 4. Expelling, ejecting, 5. Spitting, spitting out any thing with sickness or disgust. 	 6. Kill-ing, destroying.  E. निर् out or forth. अस् to throw ल्युट् affix or युच्
निरस्त: निरस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 	 1. Expelled, sent forth or out. 	 2. Sent, thrown, cast, directed. 	 3. Thrown off, (as from a horse.) 	 4. Abandoned, deserted, left. 	 5. Rejected, disallowed. 	 6. Shot, (as an arrow,) 	 7. Uttered ra pidly, hurried. 	 8. Destroyed, 9. Gone, absent, what is not. 	 10. Suppressed, checked. 	 11. Torn or taken. 	 12. Broken, (as an agreement.)  E. निर् out or forth, अस् to throw or send, affix कर्मणि क्त.
निरस्य: निरस्य ind. Having ejected or thrown out. 	 2. Having expelled, &c. E. निर् and अस् to throw. ल्यप् aff.
निरस्यत्: निरस्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) 	 1. Ejecting, thrown out. 	 2. Abandoning, neglecting. 	 3. Expelling. 	 4. Scattering. 	 5. Destroying, &c.  E. निर् out, अस् to throw, शतृ aff.
निरस्यमान: निरस्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Being suppressed or checked. 	 2. Being ab-andoned 3. Suppressing. 	 4. Expelling. 	 5. Scattering, &c.  E. निर् before, अस् to throw, either a. or p. voice, शानच् aff.
निरहङ्कार: निरहङ्कार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Humble, free from pride.  E. निर् neg. अहङ्कार pride.
निराकरण: निराकरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Obstruction, opposition, contradiction. rejection. 2. Refutation, reply. 	 3. Holding in consideration, making light of, contempt, disesteem. 	 4. Expelling, turning out or away. 	 5. Throwing out or off. 	 6. Neglecting the chief sacrificial or religious duties.  E. निर् privative particle, and आङ् before, कृ to do or make, affix ल्युट्.
निराकरिष्णु: निराकरिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 	 1. Obstructive, obstructing. 	 2. Disdaining, despising.  E. निर्, and आङ् before कृ, affix शोलार्थे इष्णुच्.
निराकार: निराकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Devoid of form or figure. 	 2. Formless. 3 Disguise. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. Heaven. 	 2. VISHṆU. 	 3. SĪVA. 	 4. The divine spirit, God. 	 5. Reproach, censure.  E. निर. implying negative or depreciation, and आकार shape, &c.
निराकुल: निराकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Calm, steady, unperplexed, unconfused.  E. निर् neg. आकुल agitated.
निराकृत: निराकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Removed, rejected, set aside. 	 2. Refuted, replied to. 	 3. Made light of, contemned, despised. 	 4. Expelled, turned out. 	 5. Thrown from or off. 	 6. Divorced.  E. निरा, and कृत done, with आङ् prefixed.
निराकृति: निराकृति mfn. (-ति-तिः-ति). 	 1. A person who has not duly gone through a course of study, especially applied however to the religious student, who has not duly read the Vedas. 	 2. One who neglects the five great religious obligations. 	 3. Shapeless, formless, viewless. 	 m. (-तिः) 	 1. Rejection, contradiction, opposi-tion, disallowance. 	 2. Obstacle, impediment.  E. निरा implying privation or obstruction, कृति making, causing; or निर् private and आकृति form. निर + आ + कृ क्तिन् or कर्त्तरि क्त्रिच् ।
निराक्रोश: निराक्रोश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Unaccused, unreviled.  E. निर्, and आक्रोश exclaiming.
निरागस्: निरागस् mfn. (-गाः-गाः-गः) Sinless, faultless,  E. निर् neg. आगस् sin.
निराचार: निराचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Lawless, corrupt, barbarian, depraved. E. निर् not, आचार moral ordinances: it is especially applied to those people who have not the ordinances of the Vedas or distinction of Casts, &c. and comprises all, therefore, except Hindūs.
निरातपा: निरातपा f. (-पा) Night.  E. निर् not, none, and आतप sunshine.
निरादिष्ट: निरादिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Given, paid, (as a debt) delivered.  E. निर्, and आदिष्ट shown.
निरादेश: निरादेश m. (-शः) Payment, discharge, delivery.  E. निर्, and आङ् before, दिश् to show, affix घञ्.
निरानन्द: निरानन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Causing no pleasure, undelighting.  E. निर् neg. आनन्द happiness.
निरापद्: निरापद् mfn. (-द् or -त्) Prosperous, fortunate.  E. निर् neg. आपद् misfortune.
निराबाध: निराबाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Frivolously or unreally vexatious, (as a cause of complaint.)  E. निर् private, आङ् before, बाधा pain, annoyance.
निरामय: निरामय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Well, hale, recovered from sickness. 	 m. (-यः) 1. A wild goat. 	 2. A hog, a boar.  E. निर् not, आमय sickness.
निरामालु: निरामालु m. (-लुः) The wood apple: see कपित्थ.
निरामिषाशिन्: निरामिषाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 	 1. Living without meat. 	 2. Free from sensual desires.  E. निर्, आमिष flesh, अशिन् who eats.
निराय: निराय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Having no income or profit, yielding none &c.  E. निर् neg. आय receipt.
निरायत: निरायत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Contracted, compact.  E. निर् neg. आयत spread.
निरायव्ययवत्: निरायव्ययवत् m. (-वान्) An idler who lives by clandestine means, has neither income nor expenditure.  E. निर्, आय income, व्यय expense, मतुप् aff.
निरायास: निरायास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Not giving trouble, ready, easily attainable. E. निर् neg. आयास exertion.
निरायुध: निरायुध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Unarmed, defenceless.  E. निर् neg. आयुध a weapon.
निरालम्ब: निरालम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) 	 1. Self-supported, not relying on another. 2. The supreme being.  E. निर्, आलम्ब stay.
निराश: निराश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 	 1. Hopeless, despairing. 	 2. Disappointed. E. निर्, and आश hope.
निराशिस्: निराशिस् mfn. (-शिः-शिः-शिः) Without a blessing.  E. निर्, and आशिस् blessing.
निराश्रय: निराश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Without refuge, destitute.  E. निर्, and आश्रय an asylum.
निरास: निरास m. (-सः) 	 1. Opposing. rejecting. 	 2. Dispension. 	 3. Ejecting. expelling. 	 4. Removal. 	 5. Abandonment. 	 6. Vomitting.  E. निर् out, and अस to be, भावे घञ् ।
निरासन: निरासन n. (-नं) 	 1. Rejection, contradiction. 	 2. Killing, destroy-ing. 	 3. spitting out.  E. निर् before, अस् to be, &c. with आङ् prefixed and ल्युट् affix; also निरसन.
निराहार: निराहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Fasting through necessity or choice.  E. निर् privative, आहार food.
निरास्पद: निरास्पद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 	 1. Restless, anxious, unappeasable. 	 2. Homeless, portionless.  E. निर् neg. आस्पद station.
निरिङ्गिणी: निरिङ्गिणी f. (-णी) A veil.  E. निर् negative, अङ्ग a hint, इनि and ङीप् affs. निभृतमङ्गं निरङ्गं तदस्त्यस्या आच्छादत्वेन इनि ङीप् ।
निरिन्द्रिय: निरिन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Imperfect, mutilated, maimed.  E. निर् privative, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
निरीक्षण: निरीक्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. Looking at, regarding, seeing. 	 2. Expecting. E. निर्, and ईक्षण seeing.
निरीक्षत्: निरीक्षत् mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षन्ती-क्षत्) 	 1. Looking at, regarding. 	 2. Ex-pecting, hoping.  E. निर्, and ईक्षत् seeing.
निरीक्षमाण: निरीक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Looking at, regarding. 	 2. Hoping, expecting.  E. निर् before, ईक्ष् to see, शनच् aff.
निरीक्षा: निरीक्षा f. (-क्षा). 	 1. Looking at, regarding. 	 2. Hope, expectation. E. निर् before, ईक्ष् to see. अङ् and टाप् aff.
निरीक्षामाण: निरीक्षामाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being regarded or looked at.  E. निर् and ईक्ष to see, pass. शानच aff.
निरोक्षित: निरोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Seen beheld, looked at. 	 2. Hoped, ex-pected.  E. निर्, and ईक्षित seen.
निरीश: निरीश(ष) n. (-शं) The body of a plough.  E. ईश or ईष the shaft of the plough, and निर् forth or from, prefixed; hence also निरीष n. (-षं).
निरीह: निरीह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Indifferent, desireless, unanxious.  E. निर् neg. ईह who seeks.
निरीहता: निरीहता f. (-ता) Indifference, absence of effort or wish to get any-thing.  E. तल् added to the preceeding; also with त्व, निरीहत्वं.
निरुक्त: निरुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Said, described. 	 2. Obscure, obsolete. 	 n. (-क्तं) 	 1. One of the Vedāngas or works considered as supple-mentary to and connected with the Vedas, forming a part of the scriptural or sacred science: glossarial explanation of obscure terms especially those occurring in the Vedas. 	 2. Explanation of the concord or disagreement of letters, &c. 	 3. Separation or analysis of a derivative or compound word. 	 4. The name of the Yāskās commentary on the Nighantus. 	 5. Loud, Distinct.  E. निर् negative or affirmative prefix, उक्त spoken, said.
निरुक्ति: निरुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) The Vedanga or portion of the scriptural science, which explains obscure and obsolete terms. 	 2. Explanation of words. 	 3. An artificial explanation of the derivation of a word; (In rhetoric). see the last.  E. निर्, and उक्ति saying, or निर् + वच-क्तिन् ।
निरुच्यमान: निरुच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being uttered or said.  E. निर्, and उच्यमान being spoken.
निरुच्छास: निरुच्छास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Breathless. 	 2. Narrow, contracted, crowded. E. निर् and उच्छास breathing.
निरुत्तर: निरुत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Non-plussed, without an answer.  E. निर्, and उत्तर an answer.
निरुत्साह: निरुत्साह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Indolent, indifferent.  E. निर् neg. उत्माह effort.
निरुत्सुक: निरुत्सुक mfn. (-कः-का-क) Unanxious, unregretting.  E. निर् neg. उत्सुक sorrowing for.
निरुद्ध: निरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Stopped, checked, restrained, hindered. 	 2. Confined, imprisoned.  E. नि, and रुद्ध hindered.
निरुद्धप्रकष: निरुद्धप्रकष(स) m. (-षः or सः) Stricture of the urethra.  E. निरुद्ध, and प्रकष what pains.
निरुद्धशमवृत्ति: निरुद्धशमवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Wearied, tired.  E. निरुद्ध, and शमवृत्ति repose.
निरुद्द्राव: निरुद्द्राव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Immoveable, undecaying.  E. निर्, and उद्द्राव going away.
निरुद्विग्न: निरुद्विग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Sedate, free from perturbation.  E. निर्, and उद्विग्न perturbed.
निरुद्योग: निरुद्योग mfn. (-गः-गः-गं) Causeless, groundless.  E. निर् negative, उद्योग cause.
निरुन्धत्: निरुन्धत् mfn. (-न्धन्-न्धन्ती-न्धत्) Hindering, checking, suppressing.  E. नि before, रुध to hinder, शतृ aff.
निरुन्धान: निरुन्धान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Hindering, opposing. 	 2. Preventing, depriving of.  E. नि before, रुध to hinder, शानच् aff.
निरुपद्रव: निरुपद्रव mfn. (-वः-वा-) Free from any national distress or affliction, free from tyranny.  E. निर्, and उपद्रव violence.
निरुपप्लव: निरुपप्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Free from trouble or alarm.  E. निर् and उपप्लव calamity.
निरुपम: निरुपम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Unequalled, having no resemblance or likeness. E. निर्, and उपमा similitude.
निरुपेक्ष: निरुपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Honest, free from trick or fraud.  E. निर्, and उपेक्षा trick.
निरूढ: निरूढ mfn. (-ढ-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Conventional, accepted, (as the meaning of technical words or names in opposition to their etymological sense alone.) 	 2. Unmarried 3. Inherent. 	 m. (-ढः) 	 1. The force or applica-tion of words, according to their natural or received meanings, (in Rhetoric) 	 2. (In Logic,) The implied description of any property in the term designing it, (as of redness in the word red, &c.) E. नि affix, and रूढ ascended; or निर् neg. ऊढ married.
निरूपण: निरूपण n. (-णं) 	 1. Sight, seeing. 	 2. Doubt, discussion, investigation. 3 Ascertaining, determining. 	 4. Searching, looking for. 	 5. Form, shape.  E. नि implying certainty, रूप to have form, affix ल्युट्.
निरूपणीय: निरूपणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be discussed, to be investigated. 	 2. To be sought or looked for.  E. नि before, रूप to have form, अनीयर् aff.
निरूपयत्: निरूपयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Searching, looking for. 	 2. Investigating, considering.  E. नि, रूप to have form, शतृ aff.
निरूपित: निरूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Seen, beheld. 	 2. Ascertained. 	 3. Discovered, found. 	 4. Appointed, deputed, directed to do any thing. 	 5. Con-sidered, weighed.  E. नि before, रूप to have form, affix क्त.
निरूप्य: निरूप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be seen or ascertained. ind. Having seen or considered,  E. नि before, रूप to have form, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
निरूप्यत्व: निरूप्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Ascertaining, determining.  E. त्व added to the last: also with तल् निरूप्यता.
निरूह: निरूह m. (-हः) 	 1. A complete sentence, one having no ellipsis. 	 2. Certainty, ascertainment. 	 3. Logic, disputation. 	 4. An enema, one not of an oily kind.  E. निर् privative, and ऊह reasoning, &c. करणे घञ् ।
निरूहण: निरूहण n. (-णं) 	 1. Ascertaining. 	 2. Administering enemata not of an oily kind.  E. निर before, ऊह to reason, affix ल्युट्.
निरृति: निरृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Free from violence, tyranny, &c. 	 m. (-तिः) A demi-god and ruler of the south-west quarter: see नैरृति f. (-तिः) 1. Misfortune, calamity. 	 2. Security, prosperity, immunity from tyranny or violence.  E. निर् implying reverse, ऋति good fortune, &c.
निरृथ: निरृथ m. (-थः) The Sāma Veda.  E. निर्, ऋ to go, Unādi affix थक्.
निरेभ: निरेभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भ) Silent, noiseless.  E. नि neg. रेभ sounding.
निरोध: निरोध m. (-धः) 	 1. Loss, destruction. 	 2. Opposition, hindrance, check, restraint, prevention. 	 3. A version, disfavour, dislike. 	 4. Preserving. 5. Confinement.  E. नि before, रुध् to oppose, affix भावे घञ्.
निर्ग: निर्ग m. (-र्गः) Country, region, place or province.  E. निर् forth, गम् to go, affix अधिकरणे ड.
निर्गत: निर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Gone out or forth. 	 2. Expended, extinct, de-parted.  E. निर् out, गत gone.
निर्गन्ध: निर्गन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Inodorous, void of fragrance or smell.  E. निर् neg. गन्ध smell.
निर्गन्धन: निर्गन्धन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter.  E. निर्, affirmative particle, गन्ध to hurt, affix ल्युट्.
निर्गन्धपुष्पी: निर्गन्धपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) The Simul or silk cotton tree.  E. निर्गन्ध, पुष्प a flower, ङीष् aff.
निर्गम: निर्गम m. (-यः) 	 1. Going forth or out, exit. 	 2. Total loss or departure. E. निर् out, गम going; also निर्गमन and निर्गति.
निर्गुण: निर्गुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Void, of all properties. 	 2. Bad, worthless, having no good qualities. 	 3. Stringless. 	 m. (-णः) The Supreme Being, or any deity so considered.  E. निर् privative, and गुण a property, an excellence.
निर्गुणत्व: निर्गुणत्व n. (-त्वं) The state of being free from all qualities, an attribute especially of the Supreme Being.  E. निर्गुण, and त्व affix; also with तल्, निर्गुणता.

निशारत्र: निशारत्र m. (-त्रः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. Camphor.  E. निशा night, and रत्न a jewel.
निशारुक: निशारुक n. (-कं) An air, a sort of musical composition, played as an accomplishment to dancing.
निशावृन्द: निशावृन्द n. (-न्दं) A number of nights.  E. निशा, and वृन्द a many.

निष्क: निष्क r. 10th cl. (निष्कयते) To measure or weigh.

निष्क mn. (-ष्कः-ष्कं) 	 1. A weight of gold, applied however to different quantities: it is considered as synonimous with the Dināra of thirty-two small, or sixteen large Rattis; with the Karsha or Suvarṇa of sixteen Māshās; with the Pala of four or five Suvar-ṇas; and with the larger Pala or Dināra, which is sometimes reckoned at 108, and other times at 150 Suvarṇas. 	 2. Gold in general. 	 3. Any ornament of the breast. 	 4. An ornament of the neck. 	 5. A weight of four Māshās. 	 6. A weight of silver of four Suvarṇas. 	 7. A value of sixteen Kāhons or Dramyas. 	 8. A chan-dāla.  E. नि before, सद् to go, Unādi aff. कन्, and the radical final rejected or निस् + कै-क or निष्क-अच् ।
निष्कण्टक: निष्कण्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Without thorns. 	 2. Free from trouble. E. निर् neg. कण्टक a thorn.
निष्कण्ठ: निष्कण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A plant, (Capparis trifoliata) &c.; see वरुणा.
निष्कर्मन्: निष्कर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Exempt from or neglecting religious rites, worldly acts, &c.  E. निर् neg. कर्म्मन् act.
निष्कर्म्मन्: निष्कर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Exempt from or neglecting religious rites, worldly acts, &c.  E. निर् neg. कर्म्मन् act.
निष्करुण: निष्करुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Cruel unpitying, unmerciful.  E. निर् neg. करुण compassionate.
निष्कल: निष्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Waned, diminished. 	 2. Impotent, seedless, barren. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. Pudendum muliebre. 	 2. A name of BRAMHĀ. 3. A fancied personification of BRAMHĀ, for religious cere monies. f. (-ला or -ली) A woman past child bearing, in whom menstruation has ceased.  E. निर् gone, lost, कल a part &c.
निष्कर्ष: निष्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) 	 1. Certainty, ascertainment. 	 2. Drawing out. 	 3. The chief point. 	 4. Measuring.  E. निर् before, कृष् to plough, घञ् aff.
निष्कार्मा: निष्कार्मा mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Free from wish or desire. 	 n. adv. (-मं) Un-willingly.  E. निर् neg. काम desire.
निष्कारण: निष्कारण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Causeless, groundless.  E. निर् neg. कारण cause.
निष्कारुष: निष्कारुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Of a noble, not degraded.
निष्कालक: निष्कालक m. (-कः) A penitent, shaved and smeared with Ghee.
निष्काश: निष्काश(स) m. (-शः or सः) 	 1. A portico, a vārāndā. 	 2. Exit, egress. 	 3. Day break.  E. निर् and कश् to go, भावे घञ् aff.
निष्काशित: निष्काशित mfn. (-तः -ता -तं) 	 1. Expelled: see the next.
निष्कासित: निष्कासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Expelled, dismissed, turned out. 	 2. Gone forth or out, issued. 	 3. Placed, deposited. 	 4. Placed over, appoint-ed, stationed. 	 5. Reviled, reproached, 6. Opened out, blown, expanded.  E. निर् out, कस् to go, in the causal form, aff. क्त, र be-comes ष or Visarga: see निःकासित; also निष्काशित.
निष्कासिन्: निष्कासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Who or what expels. 	 f. (-नी) A female slave not restrained by her master.  E. निर् forth, कस् to go, causal form, णिनि aff.
निष्कुट: निष्कुट m. (-टः) 	 1. A pleasure grove near a house. 	 2. A field. 	 3. A door. 4. The private apartments, the Zenana. 	 5. The harem of a king. E. निर् without, कुट the house. 	 f. (-टा, also -टिः or -टी) Large carda-moms.  E. निर् out, कुट the shell or husk, aff. क, with टाप् fem. aff. or कि with ङीष् optionally added.
निष्कुम्भ: निष्कुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A plant, commonly Danti.  E. निर् forth, ष्कुम्भ a Sautra root, to spread, aff. अच्; also निःकुम्भ.
निष्कुषित: निष्कुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, extracted, forced or drawn out. E. निर् neg. कुष् to extract, aff. निष्कर्षे-क्त ।
निष्कुह: निष्कुह m. (-हः) The hollow of a tree.  E. निर् affirmative prefix, कुह् to astonish, aff. अच्.
निष्कृत: निष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Regardless, negligent. 	 2. Disregarded, thought nothing of. 	 3. Pardoned. 	 4. Undone.  E. निर् neg. कृत made.
निष्कृति: निष्कृति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Pardon, absolution. 	 2. Expiration. 	 3. Escaping from, avoiding the consequence of anything. 	 4. Undoing, doing away. 	 5. Disregarding, neglecting. 	 6. Acquittance, compensation, discharge of a debt or obligation.  E. निर् neg. कृ to do, क्तिन् affix.
निष्कोषन: निष्कोषन n. (-नं) 	 1. Taking away. 	 2. Extracting, extirpating. 	 3. Hus-king, shelling.  E. निर् before, कुष् to expel, aff. ल्युट्.
निष्कोषितव्य: निष्कोषितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be taken away.  E. निर् out, कुष् to expel, तव्य aff.; also निष्कोषणीय ।
निष्क्रम: निष्क्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Any intellectual faculty, as attention, comprehen-sion, &c. 	 2. Degradation, baseness, inferiority of tribe, family, &c. 3. Going out, exit. 	 4. Intellectual faculty.  E. निर् assuredly or forth, and क्रम going.
निष्क्रमण: निष्क्रमण n. (-णं) 	 1. Going forth or out. 	 2. Taking a child for the first time out of the house, in the fourth month, considered as an essential ceremony, and accompanied by sacrifice, &c. E. निर् forth, क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.
निष्क्रम्य: निष्क्रम्य ind. Going forth,  E. निर्, क्रम् to go, ल्यप् aff.
निष्क्रय: निष्क्रय m. (-यः) 	 1. Hire, wages. 	 2. Reward. 	 3. Barter. 	 4. Price. 	 5. Ran-som.  E. निर् before, क्री to buy, aff. अच्.
निष्क्रान्त: निष्क्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Gone out, gone, departed.  E. निर् out, क्रम् to go, aff. क्त.
निष्क्रिय: निष्क्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Abstaining from ceremonial rites. 	 2. Idle, unoccupied. 	 n. (-यं) BRAMHĀ or the Supreme Spirit.  E. निर neg. क्रिया act.
निष्क्वाथ: निष्क्वाथ m. (-थः) Broth, soup.  E. निर् before, क्वथ् to decoct, aff. घञ्.
निष्ट्य: निष्ट्य m. (-ष्ट्यः) A man of one of the outcast or barbarous tribes.
निष्टप्त: निष्टप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 	 1. Well done, dressed or cooked. 	 2. Burnished, made bright.  E. निर्, and तप्त heated.
निष्ठ: निष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 	 1. Staying, being in, who or what stays or is in or on anything. 	 2. Believing, faithful. 	 3. Skilled in. 4. Devoted to. 	 f. (-ष्ठा) 	 1. The catastrophe of a drama, the conclusion of a fable. 	 2. Conclusion in general, end, termination. 	 3. Disappearance, loss, destruction. 	 4. Confirmation, completion. 	 5. Asking, begging. 	 6. Ordinary and uniform practice or profession. 	 7. Good conduct, excellence. 8. Religious practice, devout and austere exercise. 	 9. Faith, belief. 	 10. Condition, state. 	 11. Fixed time of life, &c. 	 12. Trouble, distress, anxiety. 	 13. The technical term for the past participial affixes क्त and क्तवतु.  E. नि completely, assuredly, स्था to stay or stop, क्त aff.
निष्ठान: निष्ठान n. (-नं) Sauce, condiment.  E. नि before, स्या to stay, aff ल्युट्.
निष्ठित: निष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Firm, fixed. 	 2. Certain, ascertained. 	 3. En-gaged in, attached to, devoted to. 	 4. Staying, being in or on. E. नि before, स्था to stay, क्त aff.
निष्ठीवन: निष्ठीवन n. (-नं) Spitting, spitting out, ejecting any thing from the mouth.  E. नि before, ष्ठिव to object, aff. ल्युट्; also निष्ठेवन and निष्ठीव ।
निष्ठुर: निष्ठुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Harsh, contumelious (as speech.) 	 2. Hard, solid. 	 3. Cruel. 	 4. Severe.  E. नि before, स्था to be, to be firm, aff. उरच् ।
निष्ठुरता: निष्ठुरता f. (-ता) Harshness of speech, reviling, abuse.  E. निष्ठुर, and तल् aff., also with त्व, निष्ठुरत्व.
निष्ठ्यूत: निष्ठ्यूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Cast, thrown, sent, directed, despatched. 	 2. Ejected from the mouth, spit.  E. नि before, ष्ठिव् to eject, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
निष्ठ्यूति: निष्ठ्यूति f. (-तिः) Spitting, spitting out.  E. नि before, ष्थिव् to eject from the mouth, aff. क्त.
निष्ठेव: निष्ठेव subst. 	 mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Spitting, spitting out, ejecting any thing from the mouth.  E. नि before, ष्ठिव् to eject, aff. घञ्; also निष्ठीव.
निष्ठेवन: निष्ठेवन n. (-नं) Spitting. E. See the last; also निष्ठीव.
निष्ण: निष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Skilful, &c. see the next.  E. नि + स्ना + क ।
निष्णात: निष्णात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Skiful, clever, conversant, learned. 	 2. Perfect, superior, supreme. 	 3. (In law,) Agreed upon.  E. नि before, स्ना to bathe, aff. कर्त्तरि-क्त; also with ड, निष्ण.
निष्पक्क: निष्पक्क mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Decocted, infused, boiled.  E. निर् before, पक्व ripe or cooked.
निष्पङ्क: निष्पङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Pure, free from mud or filth.  E. निर् neg. पङ्क mud.
निष्पतत्: निष्पतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Issuing, going forth or out.  E. निर् before, पत् to go, शतृ aff.
निष्पतन: निष्पतन n. (-नं) Going forth or out, issuing.  E. निर्, and पतन going.
निष्पत्ति: निष्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Completion, conclusion, termination, consumma-tion. 	 2. Birth, production. 	 3. Going forth or out.  E. निर् negative, पद् to go, aff. क्तिन्.
निष्पत्राकृति: निष्पत्राकृति f. (-तिः) Excessive bodily pain.  E. निष्पत्र + डाच् + क-भावे क्तिन् ।
निष्पन्द: निष्पन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Motionless.  E. निर् not, स्पदि to shake or move, aff: अच्; also निष्पन्न.
निष्पन्न: निष्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Done, finished, concluded, completed. 	 2. Born, produced. 	 3. Motionless. 	 4. Gone forth or out of.  E. निर् affirmation or negation, and पन्न gone, from पद् to go, aff. क्त.
निष्पराक्रम: निष्पराक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Weak, destitute of power.  E. निर् neg. पराक्रम valour.
निष्परिग्रह: निष्परिग्रह m. (-हः) An ascetic, one who has no family nor dependants. E. निर् neg. परिग्रह dependants.
निष्पादन: निष्पादन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Doing, effecting, accomplishing. 	 2. Concluding. 3. Producing, causing, engendering.  E. निर् forth, पद् to go, causal form, aff. युच् ।
निष्पादित: निष्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done, effected, made produced.  E. निर् forth, पद् to go, causal form, क्त aff.
निष्पाद्य: निष्पाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be done, to be effected or accomplished. E. निर forth, पद् to go, causal form यत् aff.; also निष्पादनीय and निष्पादयितव्य.
निष्पाद्यमान: निष्पाद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being done or made, in the course of com-pletion.  E. निर् before, पद् to go, causal form, शानच् aff.
निष्पान: निष्पान n. (-नं) Drinking.  E. निर् before, पान drinking.
निष्पाव: निष्पाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Certain, indubitable. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. Winnowing, cleaning corn, &c. 	 2. Wind, air. 	 3. The wind of the winnowing sieve or basket. 	 4. Straw, chaff. 	 5. A legume, a pod. 	 6. A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus radiatus.)  E. निर् before, पू to purify, aff. करणे घञ्.
निष्पिष्ट: निष्पिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Ground, reduced to dust or powder. 	 2. Beaten, oppressed.  E. निर्, and पिष्ट ground.
निष्पुत्त्र: निष्पुत्त्र mfn. (-त्त्रः-त्त्रा-त्त्रं) Sonless,  E. निर्, and पुत्त्र a son.
निष्पुरुष: निष्पुरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Feminine, neuter, not male. 	 m. (-षः) 	 1. a eunuch or impotent man. 	 2. A coward.  E. निर् neg. पुरुष a man.
निष्प्रतिभ: निष्प्रतिभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Stupid, frigid, dull, apathetic, ignorant. E. निर् privative, प्रतिभ brilliance.
निष्प्रत्यूह: निष्प्रत्यूह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Unobstructed, unimpeded. 	 n. adv. (-हं) Freely, without hindrance.  E. निर् neg. प्रत्यूह obstacle.
निष्प्रभ: निष्प्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Gloomy, dark, obscure.  E. निर privative, and प्रभा light.
निष्प्रयोजन: निष्प्रयोजन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Causeless, groundless.  E. निर् negative, प्रयोजन, motive, cause.
निष्पृह: निष्पृह mfn. (-हृः-हा-हं) Content, not envying any person, nor covet-ing any thing. 	 f. (-हा) A plant; also अमूला and विष्णुवल्लभा.  E. निर् not, स्पृहा envy, &c.
निष्प्रवाण: निष्प्रवाण(णि) mfn. subst. (-णः-णी-णं) New and unbleached cloth.  E. निर् gone, प्रवाणी here said to mean the weaver's brush; also निष्प्रवाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) the forms are irregular.
निष्फल: निष्फल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Barren, unfruitful. 	 2. Seedless, impotent. 	 f. (-ला or -ली) A woman past child-bearing: one in whom menstrua-tion has ceased: see निष्कल.  E. निर् priv. and फल fruit.
निसर्ग: निसर्ग m. (-र्गः) 	 1. The natural state, nature, peculiar character or condition. 	 2. Form. 	 3. Creation. 	 4. Relinquishment, abandon-ing. 	 5. Transfer, barter. 	 6. Voiding excrement.  E. नि before, सृज् to create, or to abandon, aff. घञ् ।
निसर्गज: निसर्गज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 	 1. Cognate, innate. 	 2. Produced at crea-tion.  E. निसर्ग, and ज produced.
निसिन्धु: निसिन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A shrub, (Vitex negundo:) it is also read निसिन्ध, and with कन् added निसुन्धक; the words are considered as barbar-ous: see सिन्धुवार ।
निसूदन: निसूदन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter.  E. नि before, सूद् to kill, aff. भावे ल्युट्ः also निषूदन ।
निसृता: निसृता f. (-ता) A plant commonly Teori.  E. नि + सृ-क्त स्त्रियां-आप् ।
निसृष्ट: निसृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Delivered, deposited. 	 2. Centrical, middle. 3. Permitted. 	 4. Abandoned.  E. नि before, सृज् to go, aff कर्मणि-क्त ।
निसृष्टार्थ: निसृष्टार्थ m. (-र्थः) A messenger, an envoy, an ambassador: one who decides upon his own discretion, knowing the intents of both parties.  E. निषृष्ट deposited, अर्थ meaning.
निस्तनी: निस्तनी f. (-नी) A pill, a bolus, a sort of force-meat ball.  E. नि before, स्तन a breast, ङीप् diminutive aff.
निस्तरण: निस्तरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Going out or forth. 	 2. Crossing over or pass-ing. 	 3. Extraction, getting rid of or free from. 	 4. Means of suc-cess, an expedient, a plan,  E. निर् before, तॄ to cross or pass over, aff. करणे ल्युट् ।
निस्तब्ध: निस्तब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 	 1. Paralysed, numbered. 	 2. Stopped, fixed. E. नि before, स्तम्भ् to stop, aff. क्त ।
निस्तर्हण: निस्तर्हण n. (-णं) Killing, slaughter.  E. निर् before, तृहू to kill or hurt, aff. भावे ल्युट् ।
निस्तल: निस्तल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Round, globular. 	 2. Trembling, shaking, moving. 	 3. Down, below.  E. निर् negative or affirmative, and तल a support or stay; or depth, bottom.
निस्तार: निस्तार m. (-रः) 	 1. Getting over or across. 	 2. Getting rid of, or away from, extraction, escape. 	 3. Acquittance, requital. 	 4. Means, expedient. 	 5. Final liberation.  E. निर्, and तॄ to cross, घञ् aff.
निस्तारवीज: निस्तारवीज n. (-ञः) The cause of final liberation, faith in any deity. &c.  E. निस्तार, and वीज seed.
निस्तितीर्षत्: निस्तितीर्षत् mfn. (-र्षन्-र्षन्ती-र्षत्) 	 1. Desirous or anxious to cross. 	 2. Wishing for salvation, or to traverse the world.  E. निर् before, तॄ to cross, desid. form, शतृ aff.
निस्तुष: निस्तुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Freed from the chaff, (corn, &c.)  E. निर् neg. तुष chaff.
निस्तुषक्षीर: निस्तुषक्षीर m. (-रः) Wheat.  E. निस्तुष, and क्षीर milk.
निस्तुषरत्न: निस्तुषरत्न n. (-त्नं) Crystal.  E. निस्तुष, and रत्न a gem.
निस्तुषित: निस्तुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Left abandoned, deserted. 	 2. Skinned, peeled. 3. Pared, made thin.  E. निर् before, तुष् husk or skin, converted in to a nominal verb, and क्त participial aff.

नेत्रौषध: नेत्रौषध n. (-धं) 	 1. Green sulphate of iron considered as a collyrium. 2. Collyrium in general. 	 f. (-धी) A drug, commonly क्ॐगा.  E. नेत्र the eye, and औषघ a medicament.
नेदयत्: नेदयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Approximating, bringing near.  E. नेद for अन्तिक nom. verb, शतृ aff.
नेदिष्ठ: नेदिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 	 1. Very near. 	 2. Clever. 	 m. (-ष्ठः) A tree; (Alan-gium hexapetalum.)  E. अन्तिक near, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative, and the form irr.; also नेदीयस् with ईयसुन् aff.
नेदीयस्: नेदीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very near, nearest: see the last.
नेन्य: नेन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Taking or obtaining frequently.  E. णी to ob-tain, frequent. v., अच् aff.
नेप: नेप m. (-पः) 	 1. The family priest. 	 2. Water.  E. णी to guide, Unādi aff. प.
नेपथ्य: नेपथ्य n. (-थ्यं) 	 1. A stage, or the part behind the scenes, the tiring room, &c. 	 2. Ornament, decoration, embellishment.  E. णी to guide, विच् aff. and the vowel changed, ने the eye, or a chief, पथ्य proper, agreeable, grateful.
नेपाल: नेपाल m. (-लः) The country of Nepal.  E. ने a chief: see the last, and पाल cherishing.
नेपालिका: नेपालिका f. (-का) Arsenic.  E. नेपाल, and ठन् aff.
नेम: नेम m. (-मः) 	 1. Time, period, season. 	 2. Term, boundary, limit. 	 3. Part, portion. 	 4. A fence, a boundary wall or hedge. 	 5. A hole, a chasm. 	 6. Fraud, deceit. 	 7. Acting, dancing. 	 8. Other, dif-ferent. 	 9. Evening. 	 10. Up, above. 	 11. A root. 	 12. The founda-tion of a wall.  E. णी to gain, Unādi aff. मन्.
नेमि: नेमि f. (-मिः-मी) 	 1. The circumference of a wheel. 	 2. The framework for the rope of a well. 	 3. Edge, rim. 	 4. A windlass. 	 5. A thun-derbolt. 	 6. The earth. 	 m. (-मिः) 	 1. The twenty-second Jina or Jaina pontiff. 	 2. A sacred place, as Mathurā. 	 mf. (-मिः-मी) A tree, (Dalbergia Oujeiniensis.)  E. णी to gain or go, Unādi aff. मि.
नेमिचक्र: नेमिचक्र m. (-क्रः) A prince descended from PARĪKSHIT, who is said to have removed the capital of India to Kausāmbi, after the inundation of Hastināpur.
नेमिन्: नेमिन् m. (-मी) A tree.  E. नेमि the circumference of a wheel, इनि aff. the wood being used for its manufacture.
नेष्टृ: नेष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) One of the sixteen officiating priests at a soma sacrifice. E. णी to lead or conduct the ceremonies, Unādi aff. तृन्, and षुक् augment.
नैःश्रेयस: नैःश्रेयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Relating to final emancipation, leading to it, effecting it, &c.  E. निःश्रेयस्, and अण aff.
नैःश्रेयसिक: नैःश्रेयसिक mfn. (-कः-कीकं) Relating to final emancipation, &c. E. निःश्रेयस, and ठक् aff.
नैस्नेह्य: नैस्नेह्य n. (-ह्यं) 	 1. Dryness, austerity. 	 2. Coldness, want of affection. E. निःस्नेह, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैक: नैक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Many, various.  E. न neg. एक one.
नैवटिक: नैवटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Near, being near.  E. निकट, and ठञ् aff.
नैकट्य: नैकट्य n. (-ठ्यं) Proximity, vicinage.  E. निकट and ष्यञ् aff.
नैकभेद: नैकभेद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Various, multiform, manifold.  E. नैक, and भेद kind.
नैकरूप: नैकरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Multiform.  E. नैक, and रूप form.
नैकषेय: नैकषेय mf. (-यः-या) A Rākshasa, a fiend, goblin.  E. निकशा the mother of the race, and ढक् aff.
नैकृतिक: नैकृतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Morose, harsh-spoken. 	 2. Wicked, bad. E. निकृति, and ठक् aff.
नैगम: नैगम m. (-मः) An Upanishad or portion of the Vedas. 	 2. A sectarian, not a heretic. 	 3. A trader, a merchant. 	 4. A citizen, a towns-man. 	 5. Guiding, leading, directing. 	 6. A road, a way  E. निगम a religious obligation, aff. स्वार्थे अण्.
नैचिक: नैचिक n. (-कं) The head of an ox. 	 f. (-की) A capital cow.  E. नीकैस् low, down, चर् to go, ठक् aff. and the radical finals rejected; also नीचिकी, &c.
नैज: नैज mfn. (-जः-जी-जं) Own  E. निज, and अण् aff.
नैत्य: नैत्य n. (-त्यं) Eternity, perpetuity.  E. नित्य + व्युष्टा-अण् aff.
नैत्यक: नैत्यक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Always, constant, indispensable.  E. नित्य, and वुन् aff.
नैत्यिक: नैत्यिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Invariable, constant, perpetual, indis-pensable.  E. नित्य and ठक् aff.
नैद्र: नैद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) Sleepy, somniferous, relating or occurring in sleep.  E. निद्रा, and अण् aff.
नैधान: नैधान mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Relating to a treasure, a nest, &c. 	 f. (-नी) A boundary where some articles are buried and dug up. E. निधान a treasure, अञ् aff.
नैपाल: नैपाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Produced in Nepal. 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. Double jasmine. 2. Red arsenic. 	 3. Sephālica, (Nyctanthes tristis.) 	 4. Indigo. E. नेपाल Nepal, अण् and ङीष् affs.; brought from thence.
नैपालिक: नैपालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Produced in or brought from Nepal &c. 	 n. (-कं) Copper.  E. नेपाल, and ठेक् aff.
नैपुण: नैपुण n. (-णं) Dexterity, cleverness, skill.  E. निपुण skilful, aff. अण; also with ष्यञ् aff., नैपण्य n. (ण्यं) ।
नैमित्तिक: नैमित्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Occasional. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. An effect (opposite to “cause”) 	 2. Occasional, periodical act or rite. 	 m. (-कः) An astro-loger, a prophet.  E. निमित्त cause, ठक् aff.
नेमित्तिककर्म्मन्: नेमित्तिककर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) An occasional ceremony, such as should be observed on the birth of a child, &c.  E. नैमित्तिक, and कर्म्म act; also नैमित्तिकक्रिया, &c.
नैमिष: नैमिष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Momentary, transient, in a twinkling. 	 n. (-षं) The name of a forest. See नैमिषारण्य.  E. निमिष, and अण् aff.
नैमिषारण्य: नैमिषारण्य n. (-ण्यं) A wood celebrated as the residence of the Ṛshis, to whom Sautī related the Mahābhārat.  E. निमिष a twinkling of an eye, in which the sage GAURAMUKHA destroyed a sort of Asuras, and अण् aff. and अरण्य a forest.
नैमेय: नैमेय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange.  E. नि before, मि to measure, यत् aff. and स्वार्थे-अण् added.
नैयग्रोध: नैयग्रोध n. (-धं) The fruit of the Indian fig tree, &c.  E. न्यग्रोध the fig tree, &c. and अण् aff.
नैयङ्कव: नैयङ्कव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Made of the skin, &c. of the deer, called न्यङ्कु E. न्यङ्कु and अण् aff.
नैयत्य: नैयत्य n. (-त्यं) Self-government or subjugation.  E. नियत, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैयमिक: नैयमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) According to rule, regular, enjoined, E. नियम, and ठक् aff.
नैयायिक: नैयायिक m. (-कः) A logician, a follower of the Nyāya or logical philosophy.  E. न्याय the Nyāya system, and ठक् aff.
नैरन्तय्य: नैरन्तय्य n. (-र्य्यं) Compactness, closeness, contiguity.  E. निरन्तर, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैराश्या: नैराश्या n. (-श्यं) Despair.  E. निराश, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैरुक्त: नैरुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ती-क्तं) 	 1. Obsolete, uncommon, belonging to the glossary of the Vedas 2. Acquainted with the terms of the Ve-das. 	 3. A Philologist.  E. निरुक्ति and अण् aff.
नैरृत: नैरृत m. (-तः) 	 1. A demon, a fiend. 	 2. The ruler of the south-west quarter. 	 f. (-ती) 	 1. The south-west quarter. 	 2. An epithet of Durgā.  E. निऋति said to be a proper name, and अण् aff.
नैर्गुण्य: नैर्गुण्य n. (-न्यं) Absence of qualities or properties.  E. निर्गुण, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैर्मल्य: नैर्मल्य n. (-ल्यं) Cleanness, purity.  E. निर्मल, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैल्य: नैल्य n. (-ल्यं) Blueness, darkness of colour.  E. नील, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैवि: नैवि(ब)ड्य n. (-ड्यं) 	 1. Thickness, substance. 	 2. Closeness, compactness. 3. Continued sound.  E. निविड thick, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
नैवेद्य: नैवेद्य n. (-द्यं) An offering of eatable articles presented to a deity, and may afterwards be distributed to his ministers or worshippers, es-pecially when it has been presented to any form of VISHṆU. E. निवेद presenting, offering, ष्यञ् aff.
नैवेशिक: नैवेशिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A present to a Brāhman who is a householder, a girl so given, or ornaments with her, &c.  E. निवेश a house, aff. ठक् ।
नैश: नैश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Nocturnal, relating to the night; or a person, &c. doing any thing by night.  E. निशा night, and अण् aff. also with ठञ् aff. नैशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं ।)
नैश्चित्य: नैश्चित्य n. (-त्यं) 	 1. Certainty. 	 2. A fixed festival; as at birth, investi-ture, marriage. &c.  E. निश्चित certain, ष्यञ् aff.
नैषध: नैषध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) Relating to NISHADHA. 	 m. (-धः) A name of NALA. E. निषध the country so called, aff. अण् ।
नैष्कर्म्म्य: नैष्कर्म्म्य n. (-र्म्म्यं) 	 1. Abstinence or exemption from acts or their conse-quences. 	 2. The salvation obtained by abstraction in opposition to that obtained by works.  E. निष्कर्म्मन् and ष्यञ् aff.
नैष्कशतिक: नैष्कशतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Worth a hundred Nishkas, bought with them, &c.  E. निष्क and शत a hundred, ठञ् aff.; also with सहस्र a thou-sand नैष्कसहस्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं ।)
नैष्किक: नैष्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bought with, made of, &c. a Nishka. 	 m. (-कः) The mint-master.  E. निष्क a weight of gold, and ठक् aff.
नैष्कृतिक: नैष्कृतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Wicked, evil-doing, malignant.  E. निष्कृति, and ठक् aff.
नैष्ठिक: नैष्ठिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Relating to state or condition. 	 2. Belonging to the character or office of a perpetual student. 	 3. Firm, fixed. 4. Final. 	 5. Highest, perfect. 	 6. Completely versed in. 	 7. Vowing perpetual abstinence and chastity. 	 m. (-कः) The Brāhman who continues with his spiritual preceptor, and always remains in the condition of the religious student.  E. निष्ठा certainty, ठक् aff.
नैष्ठुर्य: नैष्ठुर्य्य n. (-र्य्य) Severity, cruelty.  E. निष्ठुर, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैष्ठुर्य्य: नैष्ठुर्य्य n. (-र्य्य) Severity, cruelty.  E. निष्ठुर, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैसर्गिक: नैसर्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Natural, innate.  E. निसर्ग nature, ठक् aff.
नैस्त्रिंशिक: नैस्त्रिंशिक m. (-कः) A swordsman, a soldier armed with a sword. E. निस्त्रिंश a sword, aff. ठक्.
नो: नो ind. No, not.  E. नह to command, aff. डो.
नोधस्: नोधस् m. (-धाः) The name of a saint.  E. नु to praise, असि Unādi aff. and धुट augment.
नोपस्थातृ: नोपस्थातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Remote, far off.  E. न negative, उप near, स्था to be, aff. तृच्.
नौ: नौ f. (-नौः) A boat, a vessel in general.  E. नुद् to send, Unādi aff. डौ.
नौका: नौका f. (-का) A boat.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
नौकादण्ड: नौकादण्ड m. (-ण्डः) An oar, a paddle.  E. नौका a boat, and दण्ड a stick.
नौतार्य: नौतार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Navigable, to be gone to or traversed in a vessel.  E. नौ, and तार्य्य to be crossed.
नौतार्य्य: नौतार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Navigable, to be gone to or traversed in a vessel.  E. नौ, and तार्य्य to be crossed.
नौयायिन्: नौयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) A passenger, a freight, who or what goes in a boat or vessel.  E. नौ, and यायिन् who goes.
न्यक्: न्यक् ind. A particle implying abuse or contempt when prefixed to कु or भू. E. The neuter of न्यञ्च used as a particle.
न्यक्करण: न्यक्करण n. (-णं) Treating with disrespect or contempt.  E. न्यक्, and करण making.
न्यक्कार: न्यक्कार m. (-रः) Contempt, disrespect.  E. न्यङ् little, low, कृ to make, aff. घञ्.
न्यक्कारुका: न्यक्कारुका f. (-का) An insect found in ordure.
न्यक्ष: न्यक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 	 1. Whole, entire. 	 2. Low, inferior. 	 m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A name of PARAŚURĀMA. 	 2. A buffalo. 	 n. (-क्षं) 	 1. A kind of grass called mahishatrina.  E. नि before, अक्ष a die &c.
न्यग्जाति: न्यग्जाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of mean or inferior race.  E. न्यक्, and जाति caste.
न्यग्भावन: न्यग्भावन m. (-नः) 	 1. Contempt. 	 2. Defiling.  E. न्यक्, and भावन con-ceiving.
न्यग्रोध: न्यग्रोध m. (-धः) 	 1. The Indian fig tree. (Ficus Indica.) 	 2. A fathom measured by the arms extended. 	 3. The Sami, (Mimosa albida) f. (-धी) 	 1. A plant, (Salvinia cucullata, Rox.) 	 2. A medical plant, commonly Mohānā.  E. न्यक् short, रुध् to impede, aff. अण्.
न्यग्रोधपरिमण्डला: न्यग्रोधपरिमण्डला f. (-ला) An elegant woman. In Vāchaspatya she is thus described: --स्तनौ सुकठिनौ यस्या नितम्बे च विशालता । मध्ये क्षीणा भवेद्या सा न्यग्रोधपरिमण्डला ॥
न्यङ्कु: न्यङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 	 1. A deer. 	 2. The name of a saint or Muni.  E. नि always, अञ्च् to go, aff. कु.
न्यङ्कुभूरूह: न्यङ्कुभूरूह m. (-हः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.)  E. न्यङ्कु a deer, and भूरुह a tree. श्योनाकवृक्षे ।
न्यङ्ग: न्यङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Low abuse.  E. न्यङ्, and ग what goes or is. According to Vāchaspatya.--m. (-ङ्गः) नितरामञ्जने  E. नि-अन्ज-घञ् ।
न्यञ्च: न्यञ्च mfn. (न्यङ्-नीची-न्यक्) 	 1. Short, dwarfish. 	 2. Low, vile, con-temptible, base. 	 3. Slow, lazy. 	 4. Whole, entire.  E. नि prefixed to अञ् to go, aff. क्विप्. निम्नतया अञ्चति, अञ्च-विच् । निम्ने क्विन् न्यच् तत्रार्थे त्रि० । शसादौ भत्वे च नीचः नीचा अन्यत्र कुत्वम् ।
न्यञ्चित: न्यञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thrown or cast down.  E. नि before, अञ्चित gone.
न्यय: न्यय m. (-यः) Loss, expense, waste, destruction.  E. नि before इ to go, aff. अच्.
न्यर्ण: न्यर्ण mfn. (-र्ण्णः-र्ण्णा-र्ण्णं) 	 1. Asked, solicited. 	 2. Gone, 3. Injured.  E. नि, अर्द्द् to ask, क्त aff.
न्यसन: न्यसन n. (-नं) 	 1. Delivering, Giving up. 	 2. Depositing.  E. नि before, अस् to throw ल्युट् aff.
न्यस्त: न्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 	 1. Deposited, consigned, delivered. 	 2. Placed in or upon. 	 3. Applied to.  E. नि before, अस् to throw or send, aff. क्त.
न्यस्तशस्त्र: न्यस्तशस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Unarmed, defenceless, having laid down or resigned weapons. 	 m. (-स्त्रः) A deified progenitor.  E. न्यस्त delivered, and शस्त्र a weapon.
न्याक्य: न्याक्य n. (-क्यं) Fried rice.  E. नि + अकि-न्यत् बा० न लीपः । “मुडि” इति भाषा ।
न्याद: न्याद m. (-दः) Eating, feeding.  E. नि before, अद् to eat, णः aff. न घसादेशः ।
न्याय: न्याय m. (-यः) 	 1. Propriety, fitness. 	 2. The Nyāya doctrine, logic, logi-cal philosophy. 	 3. Apposite illustration. 	 4. A complete argument or syllogism. 	 5. Policy, good government. 	 6. Method, way, man-ner, plan, rule. 	 7. Virtue, honesty. 	 8. Justice, law. 	 9. A law-suit. 12. Judgment. 	 13. A universal rule, (In gram.) 	 14. Likeness analo-gy. 	 15. A vedic accent.  E. नि certainly, इण to go, aff. भावकरणादौ घञ्.
न्यायता: न्यायता f. (-ता) Fitness, propriety.  E. तल् added to न्याय; also with त्व न्यायत्वं.
न्यायसारिणी: न्यायसारिणी f. (-णी) 	 1. A woman acting or judging rightly. 	 2. Right behaviour.  E. न्याय propriety, सारिणी proceeding. न्यायं सरति, सृ-णिनि ।
न्यायाचार: न्यायाचार m. (-रः) A virtuous man.  E. न्याय, and आचार observance.
न्यायाधार: न्यायाधार m. (-रः) An example of virtue or propriety.  E. न्याय, and आधार what uphelds.
न्यायिन्: न्यायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 	 1. Right, fit. 	 2. Logical.  E. न्याय, and इनि aff.
न्याय्य: न्याय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Right, proper, fit.  E. न्याय, and यत् aff.
न्यास: न्यास m. (-सः) 	 1. A deposit, a pledge. 	 2. Deserting, abandoning. 	 3. De-livering, presenting. 	 4. Mental delivering, consigning or entru-sting any thing to the mind. 	 5. Mental appropriation or assi-gnment of various parts of the body to tutelary divinities. accom-panied with certain prayers and gesticulations. 	 6. Painting, stamp, mark. 	 7. Bringing forward. 	 8. Seizing. (with the claws.) E. नि before, अस् to throw or cast away, aff. कर्मणि, भावे वा घञ्.
न्यासधारिन्: न्यासधारिन् m. (-री) The holder of a deposit, a mortgagee.  E. न्यास, and धारिन् who has.
न्यु: न्यु(न्यू)ङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) 	 1. Six-fold repetition of the triliteral name of god. 2. The Sāma Veda. 	 3. Pleasing, agreeable charming, beautiful. E. नि before, उखि to go, aff. घञ्; it is also read न्यूङ्ख.
न्युब्ज: न्युब्ज mfn. (-ब्जः-ब्जा-ब्जं) 	 1. Crooked-backed, hump-backed, 2. Looking downwards. 	 3. Bent, crooked. 	 4. Convex. 	 m. (-ब्जः) 	 1. Disease, sickness, pain. 	 2. A sort of ladle made of Kusa grass. 	 3. The Nyagrodha tree. 	 n. (-ब्जं) 	 1. The fruit of the Kāmaranga, (Caram-bola averrhoa.) 	 2. A vessel used at Shrāddhas.  E. न्युब्ज् to be crooked, aff. घञ्.
न्युब्जखड्ग: न्युब्जखड्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sabre, a crooked sword.  E. न्युब्ज crooked, and खङ्ग a sword.
न्यून: न्यून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Blamable, vile, wicked, despicable. 	 2. Less, deficient, defective.  E. नि before, ऊन less, affix अच् ।
न्यूनता: न्यूनता f. (-ता) 	 1. Deficiency. 	 2. Inferiority.  E. तल् added to न्यून, also न्यूनत्व.
न्यूनधी: न्यूनधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Ignorant, foolish,  E. न्यून, and धी intellect.
न्यूनपञ्चाशद्भाव: न्यूनपञ्चाशद्भाव m. (-वः) An idiot.  E. न्यून, and पञ्चाशत् fifty, भाव property having but forty-nine properties of human nature.
न्यूनाङ्ग: न्यूनाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Maimed, mutilated, imperfect.  E. न्यून, and अङ्ग body.
न्यूनाधिक: न्यूनाधिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unequal, more or less.  E. न्यून, and अधिक more.
न्यूनाधिकविभाग: न्यूनाधिकविभाग m. (-गः) Unequal partition.  E. न्यूनाधिक, and विभाग division.
न्यूनेन्द्रिय: न्यूनेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Imperfect, wanting some organ; as blind, deaf, &c.  E. न्यून. and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
न्रस्थिमालिन्: न्रस्थिमालिन् m. (-ली) A name of SĪVA.  E. नृ man, अस्थि a bone, माला a necklace, and इनि poss. aff.; ornamented with a garland of human skulls.
